title_en: Anytime-Valid Inference for Online Ranking of Large Language Models
title_zh: 用于大语言模型在线排名的任意时刻有效推断

sentences.en: Online evaluation of large language models increasingly relies on sequentially collected pairwise preferences, enabling human-aligned assessment and continuous data collection until closely performing models can be reliably distinguished.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型的在线评估日益依赖顺序收集的成对偏好，这使得能够进行与人类对齐的评估，并持续收集数据，直到性能相近的模型能够被可靠地区分开来。

sentences.en: However, adaptive sampling and continuous monitoring invalidate classical fixed-sample inference, rendering existing ranking procedures largely heuristic.
sentences.zh: 然而，自适应采样和持续监测会使经典的固定样本推断失效，使得现有的排名方法在很大程度上沦为启发式。

sentences.en: We propose SERPANT (Sequential E-value Ranking and Pruning via Adaptive Null Testing), a principled framework for online LLM ranking with anytime-valid guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SERPANT（通过自适应零假设检验的序贯 e-value 排名与剪枝），一个具有随时有效保证的在线 LLM 排名原则性框架。

sentences.en: SERPANT formulates model comparison as a collection of pairwise hypothesis tests and constructs e-processes to ensure family-wise error rate control at any monitoring time.
sentences.zh: SERPANT 将模型比较表述为一组成对假设检验，并构造 e-process 以确保在任何监测时刻都能控制族系错误率。

sentences.en: Anytime validity provides a theoretical justification for early stopping, enabling substantial cost savings from expensive human annotation.
sentences.zh: 随时有效性为提前停止提供了理论依据，从而能够从昂贵的人工标注中获得可观的成本节省。

sentences.en: To improve efficiency, we introduce a novel tournament-based sampling strategy that adaptively selects comparisons based on past outcomes.
sentences.zh: 为了提高效率，我们引入一种新颖的基于锦标赛的采样策略，它根据过去的结果自适应地选择比较。

sentences.en: The proposed framework is also extended to top-k model identification.
sentences.zh: 所提出的框架还被扩展到 top-k 模型识别。

title_en: AOEB: Benchmarking Agent-Oriented Multimodal Embeddings
title_zh: AOEB：评测面向智能体的多模态嵌入

sentences.en: LLM agents powered by retrieval and RAG are increasingly prevalent across research and applications.
sentences.zh: 由检索和 RAG 驱动的 LLM 智能体在研究和应用中日益普遍。

sentences.en: Embedding models play a critical role in these systems, particularly in embedding-based retrieval.
sentences.zh: 嵌入模型在这些系统中扮演着关键角色，尤其是在基于嵌入的检索中。

sentences.en: However, current benchmarks for embeddings remain focused on general-purpose scenarios, which may fail to align well with the diverse and evolving needs of agentic applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前用于嵌入的基准仍然聚焦于通用场景，这可能无法很好地与智能体应用多样化且不断演变的需求对齐。

sentences.en: To close this gap, we introduce Agent-Oriented Embedding Benchmark (AOEB), a comprehensive evaluation suite dedicated to agent-centric retrieval for embedding models.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们引入以智能体为中心的嵌入基准（Agent-Oriented Embedding Benchmark，AOEB），一个专门面向嵌入模型以智能体为中心检索的全面评估套件。

sentences.en: AOEB is characterized by two key features: (1) Multi-Task, covering five essential capabilities for retrieval in LLM agents, including code, tool, reasoning, and memory retrieval; and (2) Multi-Modal, providing evaluation with both textual and visual data for each task category.
sentences.zh: AOEB 以两个关键特征为特点：（1）多任务，涵盖 LLM 智能体中检索的五项基本能力，包括代码、工具、推理和记忆检索；以及（2）多模态，为每个任务类别提供文本和视觉数据的评估。

sentences.en: We evaluate representative embedding models on AOEB and observe that they exhibit distinct strengths across different agent-oriented retrieval tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们在 AOEB 上评估了具有代表性的嵌入模型，并观察到它们在不同以智能体为中心的检索任务上展现出各异的优势。

sentences.en: By curating AOEB, we aim to promote a move toward more practically oriented directions within the embedding community and foster further progress.
sentences.zh: 通过构建 AOEB，我们旨在推动嵌入社区向更实用的方向发展，并促进进一步的进展。

title_en: AOEPT: Breaking the Implicit Modality-Reduction Bottleneck in Modality-Missing Prompt Tuning
title_zh: AOEPT：突破模态缺失提示调优中的隐式模态缩减瓶颈

sentences.en: Deploying multimodal systems in real-world environments often entails handling modality-missing scenarios, where one or more modalities are unavailable.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界环境中部署多模态系统，往往需要处理模态缺失的场景，即一个或多个模态不可用。

sentences.en: While recent studies address this challenge for the general Multimodal Transformer (MT) architecture via prompt tuning, we identify a fundamental limitation in these methods: the Implicit Modality-Reduction bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的研究通过提示调优来解决通用多模态 Transformer（MT）架构的这一挑战，但我们识别出这些方法中的一个根本性局限：隐式模态缩减（Implicit Modality-Reduction）瓶颈。

sentences.en: By conditioning prompts solely on the observed modalities, they inadvertently restrict the reasoning scope of MTs to the modality-reduced subspace, cutting off access to the latent information sources of the missing modalities.
sentences.zh: 由于提示仅以观测到的模态为条件，它们无意中限制了 MT 的推理范围，使其局限于模态缩减的子空间，切断了对缺失模态潜在信息源的访问。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose AOEPT, which pioneers a novel modal-contextualized prompting fashion.
sentences.zh: 为了克服这一局限，我们提出 AOEPT，它开创了一种新的模态情境化提示方式。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce lightweight Modal-Contextualized Prompts (MCPs) that distill global modality-wise priors from training data, serving as latent repositories of the information sources for missing modalities.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们引入轻量级的模态情境化提示（MCP），它们从训练数据中提炼全局的模态级先验，充当缺失模态信息源的潜在存储库。

sentences.en: Conditioned on the remaining modalities, these MCPs are instantiated into instance-aware prompts that selectively augment missing-modality information for each sample, thereby restoring the reasoning scope of MTs beyond the observed-modality-only subspace.
sentences.zh: 以剩余模态为条件，这些 MCP 被实例化为实例感知的提示，为每个样本选择性地增强缺失模态信息，从而将 MT 的推理范围恢复到超越仅观测模态子空间的程度。

sentences.en: Experiments across various multimodal benchmarks and backbones confirm the strong performance of AOEPT, with minimal computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 跨各种多模态基准和骨干的实验证实了 AOEPT 的强劲性能，且计算开销极小。

title_en: AOrchestra: Automating Sub-Agent Creation for Agentic Orchestration
title_zh: AOrchestra：自动创建子智能体以实现智能体编排

sentences.en: Language agents have shown strong promise for task automation.
sentences.zh: 语言智能体在任务自动化方面展现出了强大的前景。

sentences.en: Realizing this promise for increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks has driven the rise of a subagent-as-tools paradigm for multi-turn task solving.
sentences.zh: 对于日益复杂、长时域的任务，实现这一前景推动了用于多轮任务求解的“子智能体即工具”范式兴起。

sentences.en: However, existing designs still lack a dynamic abstraction view of sub-agents, thereby hurting adaptability: sub-agents are either context-isolated threads that lack specialization, or static roles that require human-engineering.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的设计仍然缺乏对子智能体的动态抽象视角，从而损害了适应性：子智能体要么是缺乏专门化的上下文隔离线程，要么是需要人工工程的静态角色。

sentences.en: We address this challenge with a unified, framework-agnostic agent abstraction that models any agent as a tuple (Model, Task, Tools, Context).
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个统一的、与框架无关的智能体抽象来解决这一挑战，它将任何智能体建模为一个元组（模型、任务、工具、上下文）。

sentences.en: This tuple acts as a compositional recipe for capabilities, enabling the system to spawn specialized executors for each task on demand.
sentences.zh: 这个元组充当能力的一种组合配方，使系统能够按需为每个任务生成专门的执行器。

sentences.en: Building on this abstraction, we introduce an agentic system AOrchestra, where the central orchestrator concretizes the tuple at each step: it curates task-relevant context, selects tools and models, and delegates execution via on-the-fly automatic agent creation.
sentences.zh: 在这一抽象的基础上，我们引入智能体系统 AOrchestra，其中中央编配器在每一步将元组具体化：它策划任务相关的上下文，选择工具和模型，并通过即时自动智能体创建来委托执行。

sentences.en: Such designs enable reducing human engineering efforts, and remain framework-agnostic with plug-and-play support for diverse agents as task executors.
sentences.zh: 这样的设计能够减少人工工程工作量，并保持与框架无关，支持将多样化的智能体即插即用作为任务执行器。

sentences.en: It also enables a controllable performance–cost trade-off, allowing the system to approach Pareto-efficient.
sentences.zh: 它还实现了一个可控的性能-成本权衡，使系统能够接近帕累托效率。

sentences.en: Across three challenging benchmarks and environments (GAIA, SWE-Bench, Terminal-Bench), AOrchestra achieves 16.28% relative improvement against the strongest baseline when paired with Gemini-3-Flash.
sentences.zh: 在三个具有挑战性的基准和环境（GAIA、SWE-Bench、Terminal-Bench）中，AOrchestra 在与 Gemini-3-Flash 搭配时，相对于最强基线实现了 16.28% 的相对改进。

title_en: APE-Bench: Evaluating Automated Proof Engineering for Formal Math Libraries
title_zh: APE-Bench：评估形式化数学库的自动证明工程

sentences.en: While frontier formal mathematics systems now routinely develop repository-scale proof engineering artifacts requiring multi-file coordination and semantic correctness beyond compilation, existing evaluation benchmarks remain focused on isolated theorem proving.
sentences.zh: 虽然前沿的形式化数学系统现在能够常规地开发仓库规模的证明工程工件，这些工件需要超越编译之外的多文件协调和语义正确性，但现有的评估基准仍然聚焦于孤立的定理证明。

sentences.en: We introduce Automated Proof Engineering (APE), the first systematic framework for evaluating repository-scale proof engineering through dual verification that validates both syntactic compilation and semantic requirement satisfaction in pinned library environments.
sentences.zh: 我们引入自动化证明工程（Automated Proof Engineering，APE），第一个通过双重验证来评估仓库规模证明工程的系统性框架，双重验证在固定的库环境中同时检验语法编译和语义需求满足。

sentences.en: We present a complete infrastructure comprising APE-Bench, which automatically extracts proof engineering tasks from real library commit histories, and APE-Harness, a unified execution framework based on task contract abstraction.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个完整的基础设施，包括 APE-Bench（它从真实库的提交历史中自动提取证明工程任务）和 APE-Harness（一个基于任务契约抽象的统一执行框架）。

sentences.en: This contract-based design enables standardized evaluation across diverse formal mathematics tasks and fair systematic comparison of different agent implementations (including our APE-Agent reference scaffold alongside Claude Code and Codex CLI) on identical task specifications.
sentences.zh: 这种基于契约的设计能够在多样化的形式化数学任务上进行标准化评估，并在相同的任务规范上，对不同智能体实现（包括我们的 APE-Agent 参考脚手架，以及 Claude Code 和 Codex CLI）进行公平的系统性比较。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the framework's effectiveness through comprehensive evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们通过全面的评估证明了该框架的有效性。

sentences.en: All code, benchmarks, and infrastructure will be open-sourced.
sentences.zh: 所有代码、基准和基础设施都将开源。

title_en: APEX: Approximate-but-exhaustive search for ultra-large combinatorial synthesis libraries
title_zh: APEX：面向超大型组合合成库的近似但穷尽式搜索

sentences.en: Make-on-demand combinatorial synthesis libraries (CSLs) like Enamine REAL have significantly enabled drug discovery efforts.
sentences.zh: 按需制造（make-on-demand）的组合合成库（CSL）——如 Enamine REAL——极大地促进了药物发现工作。

sentences.en: However, their large size presents a challenge for virtual screening, where the goal is to identify the top compounds in a library according to a computational objective (e.g., optimizing docking score) subject to computational constraints under a limited computational budget.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们庞大的规模给虚拟筛选带来了挑战，虚拟筛选的目标是在有限计算预算下，根据计算目标（例如，优化对接分数）并受计算约束限制，识别库中的前列化合物。

sentences.en: For current library sizes---numbering in the tens of billions of compounds---and scoring functions of interest, a routine virtual screening campaign may be limited to scoring fewer than 0.1% of the available compounds, leaving potentially many high scoring compounds undiscovered.
sentences.zh: 对于当前庞大的库规模——化合物数量达数百亿——以及所关注的评分函数，一次常规的虚拟筛选活动可能只限于对不到 0.1% 的可用化合物进行评分，这可能使得众多高分化合物未被发现。

sentences.en: Furthermore, as constraints (and sometimes objectives) change during the course of a virtual screening campaign, existing virtual screening algorithms typically offer little room for amortization.
sentences.zh: 此外，随着虚拟筛选活动过程中约束条件（有时还有目标）的变化，现有的虚拟筛选算法通常几乎没有分摊的空间。

sentences.en: We propose the approximate-but-exhaustive search protocol for CSLs, or APEX.
sentences.zh: 我们提出用于 CSL 的近最优穷尽搜索协议，即 APEX。

sentences.en: APEX utilizes a neural network surrogate that exploits the structure of CSLs in the prediction of objectives and constraints to make full enumeration on a consumer GPU possible in under a minute, allowing for exact retrieval of approximate top-k sets.
sentences.zh: APEX 利用一个神经网络代理模型，它在目标和约束的预测中利用 CSL 的结构，从而可能在消费者 GPU 上一分钟内完成完整枚举，允许精确检索近似的 top-k 集合。

sentences.en: To demonstrate APEX's capabilities, we develop a benchmark CSL comprised of more than 10 million compounds, all of which have been annotated with their docking scores on five medically relevant targets along with physicohemical properties measured with RDKit such that, for any objective and set of constraints, the ground truth top-k compounds can be identified and compared against the retrievals from any virtual screening algorithm.
sentences.zh: 为了展示 APEX 的能力，我们开发了一个由超过 1000 万化合物组成的基准 CSL，所有这些化合物都已标注了其在五个医学相关靶标上的对接分数，以及用 RDKit 测得的理化性质，因此对于任何目标和约束集，都可以识别出真实 top-k 化合物，并与任何虚拟筛选算法的检索结果进行比较。

sentences.en: We show APEX's consistently strong performance both in retrieval accuracy and runtime compared to alternative methods.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了 APEX 在检索准确率和运行时间方面相较于替代方法的一贯强劲表现。

title_en: API: Adaptive Prototype Imputation for Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
title_zh: API：用于不完整多模态情感分析的自适应原型填补

sentences.en: Multimodal sentiment analysis aims to infer human emotions by integrating signals from diverse modalities.
sentences.zh: 多模态情感分析旨在通过整合来自不同模态的信号来推断人类情感。

sentences.en: However, missing modalities are common in real-world applications due to sensor failure, data corruption, or privacy concerns.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于传感器故障、数据损坏或隐私顾虑，缺失模态在现实应用中十分常见。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically follow two main paradigms: recovery-based and non-recovery-based methods.
sentences.zh: 现有的方法通常遵循两种主要范式：基于恢复的方法和基于非恢复的方法。

sentences.en: This dichotomy results in two critical limitations: I) computational inefficiency and semantic inconsistency (recovery-based methods rely on heavy generators that incur prohibitive inference latency and risk semantic drift due to lack of class-level priors);
sentences.zh: 这种二分法导致两个关键局限：I）计算低效和语义不一致（基于恢复的方法依赖重型生成器，这些生成器带来高昂的推断延迟，并因缺乏类级先验而面临语义漂移的风险）；

sentences.en: II) lack of instance specificity (non-recovery-based methods rely on static global mappings that fail to capture sample-specific affective cues).
sentences.zh: II）缺乏实例特异性（基于非恢复的方法依赖静态的全局映射，无法捕捉样本特定的情感线索）。

sentences.en: To address these gaps, we propose Adaptive Prototype Imputation (API).
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些差距，我们提出自适应原型插补（Adaptive Prototype Imputation，API）。

sentences.en: To mitigate I), we introduce Semantic-anchored Class-Temporal Prototype Estimation (SCOPE) to construct non-trainable prototypes as stable semantic anchors, promoting semantic reliability.
sentences.zh: 为了缓解 I），我们引入语义锚定的类-时间原型估计（SCOPE），以构建不可训练的原型作为稳定的语义锚点，促进语义可靠性。

sentences.en: To resolve II), we design Directional Instance-Adaptive Affine Modulation (DIAM) to dynamically modulate these anchors via direction-specific affine transformations, capturing instance-unique affective characteristics without generative overhead.
sentences.zh: 为了解决 II），我们设计方向性的实例自适应仿射调制（DIAM），通过方向特定的仿射变换动态调制这些锚点，在无生成开销的情况下捕捉实例独特的情感特征。

sentences.en: Experimental results on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI demonstrate that API outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, establishing a robust and lightweight prototype-centric paradigm for multimodal sentiment analysis.
sentences.zh: 在 CMU-MOSI 和 CMU-MOSEI 上的实验结果表明，API 优于最先进的基线，为多模态情感分析确立了一个稳健且轻量级的以原型为中心的范式。

sentences.en: The code is publicly available at https://github.com/KX-yolo/API.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/KX-yolo/API 公开获取。

title_en: APIC: Orthogonalized Neuro-Symbolic Modeling for Nonlinear Dissipative Dynamics
title_zh: APIC：非线性耗散动力学的正交化神经符号建模

sentences.en: Current data-driven scientific modeling struggles with a functional dichotomy: neural operators exhibit spectral bias in high-frequency regimes, while physics-constrained paradigms suffer from optimization pathologies.
sentences.zh: 当前数据驱动的科学建模陷入一个功能性困境：神经算子在高频区域表现出谱偏差，而物理约束范式却遭受优化病态问题的困扰。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose Adaptive Physics-Informed Computing (APIC), a neuro-symbolic meta-architecture designed with structural reconfigurability to encode diverse domain priors.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出自适应物理信息计算（Adaptive Physics-Informed Computing，APIC），一个具有结构可重构性的神经符号元架构，用以编码多样化的领域先验。

sentences.en: Crucially, APIC integrates a gradient isolation strategy that reduces interference between the optimization paths of parameter identification and residual correction, effectively mitigating gradient conflicts.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，APIC 整合了一种梯度隔离策略，它减少了参数识别与残差校正优化路径之间的干扰，从而有效缓解梯度冲突。

sentences.en: By instantiating this framework for nonlinear dissipative systems, we derive the Generalized Kuramoto-Sivashinsky-Cahn-Hilliard (G-KSCH) kernel, providing a unified representation for sparse dynamic identification.
sentences.zh: 通过将该框架实例化用于非线性耗散系统，我们推导出广义 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky-Cahn-Hilliard（G-KSCH）核，为稀疏动态识别提供了一种统一的表示。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that APIC establishes new benchmarks in 3D compressible supersonic shock wave prediction, surpassing diverse architectures (e.g., CNNs and Transformers) by substantial margins in predictive accuracy.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，APIC 在三维可压缩超声速激波预测中确立了新的基准，在预测准确率上大幅超越多种架构（例如，CNN 和 Transformer）。

sentences.en: Notably, APIC achieves Pareto-optimal performance, delivering superior precision with reduced computational overhead compared to SOTA models, while exhibiting strong cross-task adaptability across meteorological and urban traffic datasets.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，APIC 实现了帕累托最优性能，与最先进模型相比，以更低的计算开销提供更优越的精度，同时在气象和城市交通数据集上展现出强大的跨任务适应性。

title_en: Approximate Equivariance via Projection-Based Regularisation
title_zh: 通过基于投影的正则化实现近似等变性

sentences.en: Equivariance is a powerful inductive bias in neural networks, improving generalisation and physical consistency.
sentences.zh: 等变性是神经网络中一个强大的归纳偏置，能够改善泛化能力和物理一致性。

sentences.en: Recently, however, non-equivariant models have regained attention, due to their better runtime performance and imperfect symmetries that might arise in real-world applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，近期非等变模型重新受到了关注，因为它们具有更好的运行时性能，并且现实世界应用中可能出现不完美的对称性。

sentences.en: This has motivated the development of approximately equivariant models that strike a middle ground between respecting symmetries and fitting the data distribution.
sentences.zh: 这推动了近似等变模型的发展，它们在尊重对称性和拟合数据分布之间取得了一个中间立场。

sentences.en: Existing approaches in this field either rely on sampling from a group, incurring a high sample complexity, or explicitly parameterise a model as a sum of an equivariant and non-equivariant network.
sentences.zh: 这一领域的现有方法要么依赖从群中采样，招致较高的样本复杂度，要么将模型显式参数化为等变网络与非等变网络之和。

sentences.en: This work instead approaches approximate equivariance via a projection-based regulariser which leverages a layer-wise orthogonal decomposition of a network's layers into equivariant and non-equivariant components.
sentences.zh: 本工作转而通过一种基于投影的正则化器来实现近似等变性，该正则化器利用网络层的逐层正交分解，将其分解为等变和非等变分量。

sentences.en: In contrast to existing methods, this penalises non-equivariance at an operator level across the full group orbit, rather than point-wise as in sample-based approaches.
sentences.zh: 与现有方法相比，这在算子层面、跨整个群轨道上惩罚非等变性，而非像基于采样的方法那样逐点进行。

sentences.en: We present a mathematical framework for computing the non-equivariance penalty exactly and efficiently in both the spatial and spectral domains.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个数学框架，用于在空间域和谱域中精确且高效地计算非等变性惩罚。

sentences.en: In our experiments, our method consistently outperforms prior approximate equivariance approaches in both model performance and efficiency, achieving substantial runtime gains over sample-based regularisers.
sentences.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们的方法在模型性能和效率上都一致优于先前的近似等变方法，相对基于采样的正则化器实现了可观的运行时提升。

authors.name: Jan Stuehmer
authors.institution: Heidelberg Institute for Theoretical Studies / KIT

title_en: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search for Modern AI: A Projection-Augmented Graph Approach
title_zh: 面向现代 AI 的近似最近邻搜索：投影增强图方法

sentences.en: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) is fundamental to modern AI applications.
sentences.zh: 近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）是现代 AI 应用的基础。

sentences.en: Most existing solutions optimize query efficiency but fail to align with the practical requirements of modern workloads.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有的解决方案优化查询效率，却未能与现代工作负载的实际需求对齐。

sentences.en: In this paper, we outline six critical demands of modern AI applications: high query efficiency, fast indexing, low memory footprint, scalability to high dimensionality, robustness across varying retrieval sizes, and support for online insertions.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们概述了现代 AI 应用的六项关键需求：高查询效率、快速建索引、低内存占用、对高维度的可扩展性、跨不同检索规模的稳健性，以及对在线插入的支持。

sentences.en: To satisfy all these demands, we introduce Projection-Augmented Graph (PAG), a new ANNS framework that integrates projection techniques into a graph index.
sentences.zh: 为了满足所有这些需求，我们引入投影增强图（Projection-Augmented Graph，PAG），一个将投影技术整合到图索引中的新 ANNS 框架。

sentences.en: PAG reduces unnecessary exact distance computations through asymmetric comparisons between exact and approximate distances as guided by projection-based statistical tests.
sentences.zh: PAG 通过基于投影的统计检验所引导的精确距离与近似距离之间的非对称比较，减少不必要的精确距离计算。

sentences.en: Three key components are designed and integrated into the graph index to optimize indexing and searching.
sentences.zh: 三个关键组件被设计并整合进图索引中，以优化建索引和搜索。

sentences.en: Experiments on six modern datasets demonstrate that PAG consistently achieves superior queries per second (QPS)-recall performance---up to 5$\times$ faster than HNSW---while offering fast indexing speed and moderate memory footprint.
sentences.zh: 在六个现代数据集上的实验表明，PAG 一致地实现更优的每秒查询数（QPS）-召回性能——比 HNSW 快多达 5 倍——同时提供快速的建索引速度和适中的内存占用。

sentences.en: PAG remains robust as dimensionality and retrieval size increase and naturally supports online insertions.
sentences.zh: 随着维度和检索规模的增加，PAG 保持稳健，并自然地支持在线插入。

sentences.en: Our source code is available at: https://github.com/KejingLu-810/PAG/.
sentences.zh: 我们的源代码可在 https://github.com/KejingLu-810/PAG/ 获取。

title_en: Approximate Proportionality in Online Fair Division
title_zh: 在线公平分配中的近似比例性

sentences.en: We study the online fair division problem, where indivisible goods arrive sequentially and must be allocated immediately and irrevocably.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在线公平分配问题，其中不可分割的商品顺序到达，并且必须立即且不可撤销地分配。

sentences.en: Prior work establishes strong impossibility results for approximating classic notions such as envy-freeness up to one good (EF1) and maximin share (MMS) in this setting, but the approximability of proportionality up to one good (PROP1) has remained unresolved.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作在此设置下为逼近诸如至多一件商品的免嫉妒（EF1）和最大公平份额（MMS）等经典概念建立了强不可能性结果，但至多一件商品的成比例性（PROP1）的可逼近性仍未得到解决。

sentences.en: We resolve this gap in two steps.
sentences.zh: 我们分两步解决了这一差距。

sentences.en: First, we show that three natural greedy allocation rules (standard baselines in fair division) fail to guarantee any multiplicative approximation to PROP1 against an adaptive adversary.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们表明三种自然的贪心分配规则（公平分配中的标准基线）无法保证针对自适应对手的 PROP1 的任何乘法近似。

sentences.en: These limitations motivate two relaxations: (i) restricting attention to a non-adaptive adversary, and (ii) incorporating coarse predictions in the spirit of learning-augmented algorithms.
sentences.zh: 这些局限促使了两种放宽：（i）将注意力限制在非自适应对手上；以及（ii）在类似于学习增强算法的精神下，纳入粗略的预测。

sentences.en: Under a non-adaptive adversary, we show that the uniform random allocation achieves a meaningful PROP1 approximation with high probability, and this guarantee is essentially tight for this approach; moreover, when item values are sufficiently small, the allocation is near-PROP1 with high probability.
sentences.zh: 在非自适应对手下，我们表明均匀随机分配以高概率实现一个有意义的 PROP1 近似，并且这一保证对该方法而言本质上是紧的；此外，当商品价值足够小时，分配以高概率接近 PROP1。

sentences.en: Finally, given maximum item value (MIV) predictions, we design an online algorithm that achieves robust approximation guarantees for PROP1, and degrades gracefully under one-sided prediction error.
sentences.zh: 最后，给定最大商品价值（MIV）预测，我们设计了一个在线算法，它为 PROP1 实现稳健的近似保证，并在单向预测误差下优雅地退化。

sentences.en: In contrast, we show that EF1, MMS, and PROPX remain inapproximable even with perfect MIV predictions.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们表明即使有完美的 MIV 预测，EF1、MMS 和 PROPX 仍然不可逼近。

authors.name: Tze-Yang Poon
authors.institution: Agency for Science, Technology and Research

title_en: Approximating Drift-Diffusion Models for User Decisions under Nudging and External Information
title_zh: 近似描述助推与外部信息影响下用户决策的漂移扩散模型

sentences.en: Modeling decision-making outside of controlled environments requires accounting for asynchronous, exogenous signals, such as notifications or algorithmic feeds, that dynamically alter user response times.
sentences.zh: 对受控环境之外的决策进行建模，需要考虑异步的外部信号（例如通知或算法信息流），这些信号会动态改变用户的响应时间。

sentences.en: Standard Drift-Diffusion Models (DDM) become analytically intractable when drift rates vary continuously with time.
sentences.zh: 当漂移率随时间连续变化时，标准漂移-扩散模型（DDM）在解析上变得难以处理。

sentences.en: In this paper, we derive a closed-form analytical approximation for the first-passage time distribution of a single-boundary DDM with time-dependent drift, valid in the high-threshold regime.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们为具有时变漂移的单边界 DDM 的首达时间分布推导出一个闭式解析近似，该近似在高阈值区间内有效。

sentences.en: The main result allows us to analytically study the optimal timing of external signals to maximize the probability of a user response within our approximation framework.
sentences.zh: 这一主要结果使我们可以解析地研究外部信号的最优时机，以在我们的近似框架内最大化用户响应的概率。

sentences.en: To evaluate our response time model, we conduct an extensive empirical comparison with state-of-the-art methods for user watch-time prediction and evaluation in simulated environments.
sentences.zh: 为了评估我们的响应时间模型，我们与用于用户观看时间预测和评估的最先进方法，在模拟环境中进行了广泛的实证比较。

title_en: Approximating f -Divergences with Rank Statistics
title_zh: 利用秩统计量近似 f-散度

sentences.en: We introduce a rank-statistic approximation of $f$-divergences that avoids explicit density-ratio estimation by working directly with the distribution of ranks.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种 $f$-散度的秩统计量近似，它通过直接处理秩的分布，避免了显式的密度比估计。

sentences.en: For a resolution parameter $K$, we map the mismatch between two univariate distributions $\mu$ and $\nu$ to a rank histogram on $\{ 0, \ldots, K\}$ and measure its deviation from uniformity via a discrete $f$-divergence, yielding a rank-statistic divergence estimator.
sentences.zh: 对于分辨率参数 $K$，我们将两个单变量分布 $\mu$ 和 $\nu$ 之间的失配映射为 $\{ 0, \ldots, K\}$ 上的秩直方图，并通过离散 $f$-散度测量其与均匀性的偏差，从而得到一个秩统计量散度估计器。

sentences.en: We prove that the resulting estimator of the divergence is monotone in $K$, is always a lower bound of the true $f$-divergence, and we establish quantitative convergence rates for $K\to\infty$  under mild regularity of the quantile-domain density ratio.
sentences.zh: 我们证明由此得到的散度估计器关于 $K$ 单调，始终是真实 $f$-散度的下界，并且在分位数域密度比的温和正则性条件下，我们建立了 $K\to\infty$ 时的定量收敛速率。

sentences.en: To handle high-dimensional data, we define the sliced rank-statistic $f$-divergence by averaging the univariate construction over random projections, and we provide convergence results for the sliced limit as well.
sentences.zh: 为了处理高维数据，我们通过将单变量构造在随机投影上取平均，定义了切片秩统计量 $f$-散度，并同时提供了切片极限的收敛结果。

sentences.en: We also derive finite-sample deviation bounds along with asymptotic normality results for the estimator.
sentences.zh: 我们还推导了有限样本偏差界以及估计器的渐近正态性结果。

sentences.en: Finally, we empirically validate the approach by benchmarking against neural baselines and illustrating its use as a learning objective in generative modeling experiments.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们通过与神经基线的基准对比，并演示其作为生成建模实验中学习目标的使用，对方法进行了实证验证。

title_en: Approximation Bounds for Transformer Networks with Application to Regression
title_zh: Transformer 网络的逼近界及其在回归中的应用

sentences.en: We develop approximation and statistical theory for standard Transformer networks in sequence modeling.
sentences.zh: 我们为序列建模中的标准 Transformer 网络发展了逼近和统计理论。

sentences.en: Given a sequence-to-sequence target on $[0,1]^{d_x \times n}$ whose entries are $\gamma$-Hölder for $\gamma \in (0,1]$ or belong to a first-order Sobolev class, we establish explicit $L^p$-approximation bounds for all $p \in [1,\infty]$, including the previously elusive endpoint $p=\infty$ under softmax attention.
sentences.zh: 给定一个定义在 $[0,1]^{d_x \times n}$ 上的序列到序列目标，其实体对 $\gamma \in (0,1]$ 是 $\gamma$-Hölder 的，或者属于一阶 Sobolev 类，我们为所有 $p \in [1,\infty]$ 建立了显式的 $L^p$-逼近界，包括在 softmax 注意力下先前难以触及的端点 $p=\infty$。

sentences.en: In particular, achieving error $\varepsilon$ in $L^p$-norm requires $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-d_x n/\gamma})$ parameters for $\gamma$-Hölder targets and $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-d_x n})$ parameters for Sobolev targets, matching the best known scalings in ambient dimension $d_x n$.
sentences.zh: 特别地，在 $L^p$-范数下实现误差 $\varepsilon$，对于 $\gamma$-Hölder 目标需要 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-d_x n/\gamma})$ 个参数，对于 Sobolev 目标需要 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-d_x n})$ 个参数，这与环境维度 $d_x n$ 中最优已知的缩放相匹配。

sentences.en: We further study nonparametric regression with sequential and dependent observations using Transformer networks.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步研究了使用 Transformer 网络、在序贯和依赖观测下的非参数回归。

sentences.en: Assuming stationary $\beta$-mixing covariates whose temporal dependence weakens over time, we analyze a sliding-window empirical risk minimization procedure and establish excess-risk guarantees for the Transformer-based estimators.
sentences.zh: 假设协变量是平稳的 $\beta$-混合的，且其时序依赖随时间减弱，我们分析了一个滑动窗口经验风险最小化过程，并为基于 Transformer 的估计器建立了超额风险保证。

sentences.en: Our analysis clarifies the role of attention and enables extensions beyond softmax.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析阐明了注意力的作用，并使超越 softmax 的扩展成为可能。

authors.name: Yuling Jiao
authors.institution: Zhongnan University of Ecomomics and Law

authors.name: Bokai Yan
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Approximation Error Upper and Lower Bounds  for Hölder Class with Transformers
title_zh: Transformer 对 Hölder 函数类的逼近误差上下界

sentences.en: We explore the expressive power of Transformers by establishing precise approximation error upper and lower bounds for Hölder class.
sentences.zh: 我们通过为 Hölder 类建立精确的逼近误差上界和下界，来探索 Transformer 的表达能力。

sentences.en: Specifically, a new approximation upper bound is derived for the standard Transformer architecture equipped with Softmax operators, ReLU activation functions, and residual connections.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们为配备 Softmax 算子、ReLU 激活函数和残差连接的标准 Transformer 架构推导出一个新的逼近上界。

sentences.en: We prove that a Transformer network composed of at most $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-{d_{0}}/{\alpha}})$ blocks can approximate any bounded Hölder function with $d_{0}$-dimensional input and smoothness $\alpha\in(0,1]$ under any accuracy $\varepsilon>0$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，一个由至多 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-{d_{0}}/{\alpha}})$ 个块组成的 Transformer 网络，能够在任意精度 $\varepsilon>0$ 下，逼近任何具有 $d_{0}$ 维输入和光滑度 $\alpha\in(0,1]$ 的有界 Hölder 函数。

sentences.en: In the case of approximation lower bounds, leveraging the VC-dimension upper bound, we are the first to rigorously prove that Transformers demand for at least $\Omega(\varepsilon^{-{d_{0}}/({4\alpha})})$ blocks to achieve the $\varepsilon$ approximation accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在逼近下界的情形中，利用 VC 维上界，我们是首个严格证明 Transformer 需要至少 $\Omega(\varepsilon^{-{d_{0}}/({4\alpha})})$ 个块才能达到 $\varepsilon$ 逼近精度的研究。

sentences.en: As a final step, we extend the derived results for standard Transformers to a general regression task and establish the corresponding excess risk rates demonstrating Transformers' empirical effectiveness in real-world settings.
sentences.zh: 最后一步，我们将为标准 Transformer 推导的结果扩展到一般回归任务，并建立相应的超额风险速率，证明 Transformer 在真实世界设置中的实证有效性。

authors.name: Yuling Jiao
authors.institution: Zhongnan University of Ecomomics and Law

title_en: Approximation of Log-Partition Function in Policy Mirror Descent Induces Implicit Regularization for LLM Post-Training
title_zh: 策略镜像下降中对对数配分函数的近似，为大语言模型后训练引入隐式正则化

sentences.en: Policy mirror descent (PMD) provides a principled framework for reinforcement learning (RL) by iteratively solving KL-regularized policy improvement subproblems.
sentences.zh: 策略镜像下降（PMD）通过迭代求解 KL 正则化的策略改进子问题，为强化学习（RL）提供了一个原则性的框架。

sentences.en: While this approach has been adopted in training advanced LLMs such as Kimi K1.5/K2, the ideal closed-form PMD updates require reliable partition function estimation, a significant challenge when working with limited rollouts in the vast action spaces of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种方法已被用于训练 Kimi K1.5/K2 等先进 LLM，但理想的闭式 PMD 更新需要可靠的配分函数估计，而在 LLM 广阔的动作空间中、在有限的 rollouts 下工作时，这是一个重大挑战。

sentences.en: We investigate a practical algorithm, termed PMD-mean, that approximates the log-partition term with the mean reward under the sampling policy and performs regression in log-policy space.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了一个实用算法，称为 PMD-mean，它以采样策略下的平均奖励来近似对数配分项，并在对数策略空间中执行回归。

sentences.en: Specifically, we characterize the population solution of PMD-mean and demonstrate that it implicitly optimizes mirror descent subproblems with an adaptive mixed KL--$\chi^2$ regularizer.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们刻画了 PMD-mean 的总体解，并证明它隐式地优化了带有自适应混合 KL-$\chi^2$ 正则化器的镜像下降子问题。

sentences.en: This additional $\chi^2$ regularization constrains large probability changes, producing more conservative updates when expected rewards are low and enhancing robustness against finite-sample estimation errors.
sentences.zh: 这一额外的 $\chi^2$ 正则化约束了大的概率变化，在期望奖励较低时产生更保守的更新，并增强了对有限样本估计误差的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Experiments on math reasoning tasks show that PMD-mean improves stability and remains competitive in the stale-rollout settings while enabling higher throughput through larger rollout batches.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理任务上的实验表明，PMD-mean 提升了稳定性，并在陈旧 rollout 设置下保持竞争力，同时通过更大的 rollout 批次实现更高的吞吐量。

sentences.en: These findings deepen our understanding of PMD-mean and illuminate pathways toward principled improvements in RL algorithms for LLMs.
sentences.zh: 这些发现加深了我们对 PMD-mean 的理解，并为 LLM 的 RL 算法走向原则性改进指明了道路。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/horizon-llm/OpenKimi.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/horizon-llm/OpenKimi 获取。

authors.name: Changlong Yu
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Approximation Preserving Coresets
title_zh: 保持近似性质的核心集

sentences.en: Clustering in a big data setting is an intensively studied problem, with coresets emerging as one of the important paradigms in this line of work.
sentences.zh: 大数据环境下的聚类是一个被深入研究的问题，而核心集（coresets）已成为这条研究主线中的重要范式之一。

sentences.en: Given a cost function $\text{cost}(P,S)$ mapping input points $P$ and a solution $S$ to an objective value, a coreset is a typically weighted sketch $\Omega\subseteq P$ such that $\text{cost}(\Omega,S)\approx \text{cost}(P,S)$.
sentences.zh: 给定一个将输入点 $P$ 和解 $S$ 映射到目标值的成本函数 $\text{cost}(P,S)$，核心集是一个通常加权的草图 $\Omega\subseteq P$，使得 $\text{cost}(\Omega,S)\approx \text{cost}(P,S)$。

sentences.en: In practice, coreset sizes much smaller than those suggested by theoretical guarantees are often found to be sufficient.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，人们常常发现远小于理论保证所建议的核心集规模就足够了。

sentences.en: In this paper, we offer an explanation for this phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们对这一现象给出了解释。

sentences.en: Smaller coreset sizes suffice if we only wish to preserve the costs of \emph{good} solutions, i.e., solutions with low cost.
sentences.zh: 如果我们只想保持*好*解（即低成本解）的成本，那么较小的核心集规模就足够了。

sentences.en: We define and devise \emph{approximation-preserving coresets}, which provide a weaker guarantee than strong coresets, which apply to all solutions, while providing stronger guarantees than weak coresets, which apply only to the optimum solution.
sentences.zh: 我们定义并设计*保持逼近的核心集*，它提供的保证弱于适用于所有解的强核心集，但又强于仅适用于最优解的弱核心集。

sentences.en: We complement this result by showing that even a very small distortion in the approximation factor cannot admit coresets of this size.
sentences.zh: 我们对这一结果进行了补充，表明即使逼近因子发生非常小的失真，也无法允许这种规模的核心集。

title_en: Approximation Theory for Lipschitz Continuous Transformers
title_zh: Lipschitz 连续 Transformer 的逼近理论

sentences.en: Stability and robustness are critical for deploying Transformers in safety-sensitive settings.
sentences.zh: 稳定性和鲁棒性对于在安全敏感环境中部署 Transformer 至关重要。

sentences.en: A principled way to enforce such behavior is to constrain the model's Lipschitz constant.
sentences.zh: 实施此类行为的一种原则性方式是约束模型的 Lipschitz 常数。

sentences.en: However, approximation-theoretic guarantees for architectures that explicitly preserve Lipschitz continuity have yet to be established.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于显式保持 Lipschitz 连续性的架构，逼近理论保证尚未建立。

sentences.en: In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing a class of gradient-descent-type in-context Transformers that are Lipschitz-continuous by construction.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过引入一类构造上 Lipschitz 连续的梯度下降型上下文内 Transformer 来弥合这一差距。

sentences.en: We realize both MLP and attention blocks as explicit Euler steps of negative gradient flows, ensuring inherent stability without sacrificing expressivity.
sentences.zh: 我们将 MLP 和注意力块都实现为负梯度流的显式欧拉步，在不牺牲表现力的情况下确保固有的稳定性。

sentences.en: We prove a universal approximation theorem for this class within a Lipschitz-constrained function space.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了此类在 Lipschitz 约束函数空间内的通用逼近定理。

sentences.en: Crucially, our analysis adopts a measure-theoretic formalism, interpreting Transformers as operators on probability measures, to yield approximation guarantees independent of token count.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，我们的分析采用测度论的形式体系，将 Transformer 解释为概率测度上的算子，从而得到与 token 数量无关的逼近保证。

sentences.en: These results provide a rigorous theoretical foundation for the design of robust, Lipschitz continuous Transformer architectures.
sentences.zh: 这些结果为设计稳健的、Lipschitz 连续的 Transformer 架构提供了严格的理论基础。

title_en: AppWorld-UL: Benchmarking Diverse Agent-User Interactions for Tool-Use
title_zh: AppWorld-UL：评测工具使用中多样化的智能体–用户交互

sentences.en: Tool-use agents that address day-to-day digital tasks such as ordering groceries must not only operate applications, but also interact with the user, e.g., to ask clarification questions, prompt for confirmation, and inform the user when the instruction is infeasible.
sentences.zh: 处理诸如订购杂货等日常数字任务的工具使用智能体，不仅要操作应用程序，还必须与用户交互，例如提出澄清问题、请求确认，以及在指令不可行时告知用户。

sentences.en: However, current benchmarks for evaluating agent-user interactions do not capture the diversity of such interactions.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前用于评估智能体-用户交互的基准并未捕捉此类交互的多样性。

sentences.en: Further, they operate in small environments with few, often non-state-changing, APIs.
sentences.zh: 此外，它们运作在很小的环境中，只提供很少的、往往不改变状态的 API。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce AppWorld-UL, a ``user-in-the-loop'' benchmark of 516 challenging tasks requiring diverse agent-user interactions.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一差距，我们引入 AppWorld-UL，一个包含 516 个需要多样化智能体-用户交互的挑战性任务的"用户参与"基准。

sentences.en: Building upon the AppWorld framework with 9 popular simulated apps like Amazon and Spotify, we systematically modify original tasks to introduce ambiguities and constraints that necessitate various types of agent-user interaction.
sentences.zh: 在包含 9 个流行模拟应用（如 Amazon 和 Spotify）的 AppWorld 框架之上，我们系统性地修改原始任务以引入各种需要不同类型的智能体-用户交互的歧义和约束。

sentences.en: User behavior is simulated by an LLM prompted to respond with carefully designed knowledge boundaries, offering more reliable simulation than the unconstrained or overly rigid alternatives used in prior work.
sentences.zh: 用户行为由被提示以精心设计的知识边界回应的 LLM 模拟，相比先前工作中使用的不受约束或过度僵化的替代方案，提供了更可靠的模拟。

sentences.en: Our evaluation reveals that a state-of-the-art LLM, Claude Opus 4.7, achieves only 48.6\% success on AppWorld-UL, and only 35.7\% on the harder, compositional subset.
sentences.zh: 我们的评估揭示，最先进的 LLM Claude Opus 4.7 在 AppWorld-UL 上仅达到 48.6\% 的成功率，在更难的组合子集上仅达到 35.7\%。

sentences.en: On the stricter, scenario-level metric, compositional task performance drops to only 21.3\%.
sentences.zh: 在更严格的、场景级指标上，组合任务性能降至仅 21.3\%。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that correct user-interaction is crucial for success.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，正确的用户交互对于成功至关重要。

sentences.en: This demonstrates the benchmark's difficulty and its potential to advance research on user-in-the-loop tool-use agents.
sentences.zh: 这证明了该基准的难度，以及它在推进用户参与工具使用智能体研究方面的潜力。

authors.name: Niranjan Balasubramanian
authors.institution: State University of New York, Stony Brook

title_en: Arboreal Neural Network
title_zh: 树状神经网络

sentences.en: Connectionist models and symbolic models have long embodied two divergent paradigms: the former excel at differentiable representation learning yet struggle with transparency, while the latter deliver explicit rule-based reasoning but resist gradient-based optimization.
sentences.zh: 联结主义模型和符号模型长期以来体现了两种不同的范式：前者擅长可微的表示学习，但在透明性方面存在困难，而后者提供显式的基于规则的推理，却抵制基于梯度的优化。

sentences.en: We introduce Arboreal Neural Networks (ArbNN), a neural-symbolic framework that unifies these paradigms both computationally and conceptually.
sentences.zh: 我们引入树形神经网络（ArbNN），一个在计算上和概念上都统一了这些范式的神经符号框架。

sentences.en: At the design level, ArbNN departs fundamentally from prior neuralized-tree models through a depth-aware routing mechanism and a topology-informed softmax aggregation, which together enable one-shot full-path gradient propagation and consequently achieving rapid and well-conditioned optimization dynamics.
sentences.zh: 在设计层面，ArbNN 通过深度感知的路由机制和拓扑感知的 softmax 聚合，与先前的神经化树模型有了根本性的不同，这两者共同实现了单次全路径梯度传播，从而实现了快速且良态的优化动态。

sentences.en: At the conceptual level, ArbNN reveals that decision-tree branching and self-attention routing are two realizations of the same conditional computation primitive.
sentences.zh: 在概念层面，ArbNN 揭示出决策树分支和自注意力路由是同一条件计算原语的两种实现。

sentences.en: We prove a structural isomorphism between a decision tree and a single-query attention head, enabling a differentiable architecture that faithfully preserves symbolic decision logic.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了决策树与单查询注意力头之间的结构同构性，从而能够实现一个忠实保持符号决策逻辑的可微架构。

sentences.en: The defining property of ArbNN is Bidirectional Fidelity, ensuring that the neural module can be compiled from—and losslessly decompiled back into—a symbolic tree, yielding both ordering consistency in ranking behavior and explicit, auditable interpretability via reconstructed if-else rules.
sentences.zh: ArbNN 的定义性性质是双向保真度，它确保神经模块可以从符号树编译而来，并且可以无损地反编译回符号树，从而同时产生排序行为中的顺序一致性，以及通过重构的 if-else 规则实现显式、可审计的可解释性。

sentences.en: ArbNN further supports GBDT-based initialization, allowing it to inherit strong inductive biases and integrate seamlessly with existing production workflows.
sentences.zh: ArbNN 还支持基于 GBDT 的初始化，使其能够继承强归纳偏置，并与现有的生产工作流无缝集成。

sentences.en: Empirically, ArbNN achieves state-of-the-art performance on various public tabular benchmarks and delivers consistent gains under temporal distribution shift in large-scale industrial credit-risk systems.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，ArbNN 在多个公开的表格基准上取得了最先进的性能，并在大规模工业信贷风险系统的时域分布偏移下带来了一致的收益。

sentences.en: To support realistic evaluation, we additionally construct TabCredit, a feature-rich, temporally partitioned dataset built from millions of real-world loan applications.
sentences.zh: 为了支持现实的评估，我们还构建了 TabCredit，一个从数百万真实世界贷款申请构建的、特征丰富且按时间划分的数据集。

sentences.en: Together, these results demonstrate that ArbNN forms a unified, reversible, and practically deployable bridge between symbolic reasoning and neural computation for high-stakes tabular domains.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这些结果表明 ArbNN 在高风险的表格领域，构成了符号推理与神经计算之间的一座统一、可逆且可实际部署的桥梁。

authors.name: Dongchen Li
authors.institution: University College London, University of London

title_en: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
title_zh: ArborKV：用于扩展树式大语言模型推理的结构感知 KV 缓存管理

sentences.en: Recent progress in LLM reasoning has increasingly shifted from single-pass generation to explicit search over intermediate reasoning states.
sentences.zh: LLM 推理的近期进展日益从单次生成转向对中间推理状态的显式搜索。

sentences.en: Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) organizes inference to tree-structured search with branching and backtracking, but it substantially amplifies the key--value (KV) cache: retaining KV states for a frontier of partial trajectories quickly becomes a memory bottleneck that limits throughput and constrains search depth and width under fixed hardware budgets.
sentences.zh: 思维树（ToT）将推断组织为带有分支和回溯的树结构搜索，但它大幅放大了键值（KV）缓存：为部分轨迹的边界保留 KV 状态很快成为内存瓶颈，在固定硬件预算下限制了吞吐量，并制约了搜索深度和宽度。

sentences.en: We address this challenge by observing that KV reuse in ToT-style inference is governed by search dynamics: near-term decoding depends primarily on the active branch and its ancestors, whereas inactive subtrees have low short-term reuse probability yet must remain recoverable for backtracking.
sentences.zh: 我们通过观察到 ToT 式推断中的 KV 复用受搜索动态支配来应对这一挑战：近期解码主要依赖活跃分支及其祖先，而不活跃的子树短期复用概率较低，但必须保持可恢复以支持回溯。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose **ArborKV**, a structure-aware eviction framework that couples a lightweight value estimator with a tree-aware allocation policy, and performs purely token-extractive eviction with lazy rehydration to support revisits.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出 **ArborKV**，一个结构感知的驱逐框架，它将轻量级价值估计器与树感知的分配策略相结合，并执行纯 token 抽取式驱逐配合惰性再水化以支持重访。

sentences.en: Experiments on ToT-style reasoning benchmarks show that ArborKV achieves up to $\sim4\times$ peak KV-memory reduction while preserving near-full-retention accuracy, enabling larger search configurations under fixed device budgets that would otherwise run out of memory.
sentences.zh: 在 ToT 式推理基准上的实验表明，ArborKV 实现了多达约 4 倍的峰值 KV 内存缩减，同时保持接近全保留的准确率，从而在固定设备预算下能够启用更大的搜索配置，而这些配置原本会耗尽内存。

title_en: ARC-Decode: Accelerated Decoding with Risk-Bounded Acceptance
title_zh: ARC-Decode：通过风险有界的接受机制加速解码

sentences.en: As larger language models deliver stronger capabilities, their autoregressive inference becomes increasingly expensive.
sentences.zh: 随着更大的语言模型提供更强的能力，它们的自回归推断也变得日益昂贵。

sentences.en: *Speculative decoding* accelerates generation by letting a fast draft propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel.
sentences.zh: *推测解码*让一个快速草稿模型提出 token，由目标模型并行验证，从而加速生成。

sentences.en: Yet under sampling ($T>0$), observed speedups consistently lag behind those under greedy decoding, as the classical lossless verification rule tends to over-reject low-risk drafts, leading to lower acceptance rates and limited acceleration.
sentences.zh: 然而在采样（$T>0$）下，观察到的加速一致地落后于贪心解码下的加速，因为经典的无损验证规则倾向于过度拒绝低风险的草稿，导致接受率较低和加速有限。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose **ARC-Decode** (**A**cceptance with **R**isk **C**ontrol), a training-free method that augments speculative decoding without extra forward passes.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一差距，我们提出 **ARC-Decode**（带风险控制的接受，**A**cceptance with **R**isk **C**ontrol），一种免训练的方法，它在不增加额外前向传播的情况下增强推测解码。

sentences.en: ARC-Decode enables \textbf{relaxed} acceptance by identifying drafts whose acceptance preserves the output distribution of the target model, under a risk-controlled criterion based on Jensen--Shannon divergence.
sentences.zh: ARC-Decode 通过识别那些接受后能保持目标模型输出分布的草稿，在基于 Jensen--Shannon 散度的风险控制准则下，实现**放宽的**接受。

sentences.en: It combines confidence-based pre-verification filtering with a risk-bounded acceptance criterion derived from an analytic upper bound on the potential distributional deviation.
sentences.zh: 它将基于置信度的预验证过滤，与一个源自潜在分布偏差解析上界的风险有界接受准则相结合。

sentences.en: Integrated into the state-of-the-art EAGLE-3 pipeline, ARC-Decode increases accept length per cycle and reduces verification compute, achieving up to **1.6**$\times$ end-to-end speedup over EAGLE-3 under sampling with negligible quality change across benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 集成到最先进的 EAGLE-3 流水线后，ARC-Decode 增加了每周期的接受长度并减少了验证计算，在采样下实现了比 EAGLE-3 高达 **1.6** 倍的端到端加速，且跨基准的质量变化可忽略。

title_en: ArcDAE: Asymmetric Rectified Contrastive Diffusion Autoencoder for Unified Representation Learning
title_zh: ArcDAE：用于统一表征学习的非对称校正对比扩散自编码器

sentences.en: The unification of generative details and discriminative semantics presents a structural paradox in *diffusion-based representation learning*.
sentences.zh: 生成细节与判别语义的统一，在*基于扩散的表示学习*中呈现出一个结构性悖论。

sentences.en: Early approaches decouple semantics from generation, inevitably compromising representational completeness (i.e., *information split*).
sentences.zh: 早期的方法将语义与生成解耦，不可避免地损害了表示的完备性（即*信息分裂*）。

sentences.en: While recent bridge-based methods achieve unification via a tightly coupled mapping, they suffer from *information overload*.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的基于桥接的方法通过紧密耦合的映射实现了统一，但它们遭受*信息过载*的困扰。

sentences.en: This is because unconstrained reconstruction objectives incentivize the encoder to entangle high-frequency stochastic noise into the latent bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 这是因为无约束的重建目标激励编码器将高频随机噪声纠缠进潜在瓶颈中。

sentences.en: To solve this, we introduce *asymmetric rectified contrastive diffusion autoencoder* (ArcDAE), which rebuilds the diffusion bridge as a *dynamic sifter*.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们引入*非对称整流对比扩散自编码器*（ArcDAE），它将扩散桥重建为一个*动态筛*。

sentences.en: Through imposing a *timestep-aware rectification constraint* that orthogonalizes the semantic manifold from the stochastic noise space, ArcDAE compels the bottleneck to distill discriminative features while actively shedding high-frequency redundancy.
sentences.zh: 通过施加一个*时间步感知的整流约束*，将语义流形从随机噪声空间正交化，ArcDAE 迫使瓶颈提炼判别特征，同时主动丢弃高频冗余。

sentences.en: Consequently, our approach eliminates the overload trap without reverting to decoupling.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的方法消除了过载陷阱，而无需回到解耦。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments validate the superiority of our FFHQ-trained ArcDAE, surpassing state-of-the-art methods by up to 6.4% in downstream semantics regression and 9.7% in reconstruction fidelity.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验验证了我们在 FFHQ 上训练的 ArcDAE 的优越性，在下游语义回归上超越最先进方法多达 6.4%，在重建保真度上超越 9.7%。

title_en: Architecture Matters for Multi-Agent Security
title_zh: 架构对多智能体安全至关重要

sentences.en: Multi-agent systems (MAS), composed of networks of two or more autonomous AI agents, have become increasingly popular in production deployments, yet introduce security risks that do not arise in single-agent settings.
sentences.zh: 由两个或多个自主 AI 智能体网络组成的多智能体系统（MAS），在生产部署中日益流行，然而它们引入了在单智能体设置中不会出现的安全风险。

sentences.en: Even if individual agents may exhibit robust security, architectural decisions governing their coordination can create attack surfaces that have not been systematically characterized.
sentences.zh: 即使单个智能体可能表现出稳健的安全性，支配它们协调的架构决策也可能创造出尚未被系统刻画到的攻击面。

sentences.en: In this work, we present an empirical study of how MAS design decisions shape the tradeoff between task performance and attack resistance.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们展示了 MAS 设计决策如何塑造任务性能与抗攻击性之间权衡的实证研究。

sentences.en: Using a network of web-based agents and stage-wise evaluations that distinguish planning-stage refusal, execution-stage interception, and successful attack completion, we study architectural choices through controlled experiments.
sentences.zh: 利用一个基于 Web 的智能体网络，以及区分规划阶段拒绝、执行阶段拦截和攻击成功完成的逐阶段评估，我们通过受控实验研究了架构选择。

sentences.en: We identify three key design choices that influence MAS security: (i) agent roles, which determine how authority and responsibility are allocated; (ii) topology, which shapes how and when agents interact; and (iii) memory, which determines the context and state visibility accessible to each agent.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出影响 MAS 安全性的三个关键设计选择：（i）智能体角色，它决定权威和责任如何分配；（ii）拓扑，它塑造智能体如何以及何时交互；以及（iii）记忆，它决定每个智能体可访问的上下文和状态可见性。

sentences.en: Overall, our results show that security and performance in multi-agent systems are governed by architectural design choices, motivating the development of further evaluations which move beyond the security properties of a single agent.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我们的结果表明，多智能体系统中的安全性和性能由架构设计选择所支配，这激励了超越单个智能体安全属性的进一步评估的发展。

title_en: ArcVQ-VAE: A Spherical Vector Quantization Framework with ArcCosine Additive Margin
title_zh: ArcVQ-VAE：带反余弦加性间隔的球面向量量化框架

sentences.en: Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) has become a fundamental framework for learning discrete representations in image modeling.
sentences.zh: 向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）已成为在图像建模中学习离散表示的基础框架。

sentences.en: However, VQ-VAE models must tokenize entire images using a finite set of codebook vectors, and this capacity limitation restricts their ability to capture rich and diverse representations.
sentences.zh: 然而，VQ-VAE 模型必须使用一组有限的码本向量对整个图像进行分词，而这种容量限制制约了它们捕捉丰富多样表示的能力。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose ArcCosine Additive Margin VQ-VAE (ArcVQ-VAE), a novel vector quantization framework that introduces a spherical angular-margin prior (SAMP) for the codebook of a conventional VQ-VAE.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出反余弦加性边际 VQ-VAE（ArcVQ-VAE），一个新颖的向量量化框架，它为传统 VQ-VAE 的码本引入了一个球面角度边际先验（SAMP）。

sentences.en: The proposed SAMP consists of Ball-Bounded Norm Regularization, which constrains all codebook vectors within a time-dependent Euclidean ball, and ArcCosine Additive Margin Loss, which encourages greater angular separability among latent vectors.
sentences.zh: 所提出的 SAMP 由两部分组成：球有界范数正则化，它将所有码本向量约束在一个随时间变化的欧几里得球内；以及反余弦加性边际损失，它鼓励潜在向量之间更大的角度可分性。

sentences.en: This formulation promotes more discriminative and uniformly dispersed latent representations within the constrained space, thereby enabling codebook vectors to capture richer information and leading to improved codebook utilization.
sentences.zh: 这一公式在受约束的空间内促进更具判别性、更均匀分散的潜在表示，从而使码本向量能够捕捉更丰富的信息，并带来改进的码本利用率。

sentences.en: Experimental results on standard image reconstruction and generation tasks show that ArcVQ-VAE outperforms baseline models in terms of reconstruction accuracy, representation diversity, and sample quality.
sentences.zh: 在标准图像重建和生成任务上的实验结果表明，ArcVQ-VAE 在重建准确率、表示多样性和样本质量方面都优于基线模型。

title_en: Are Common Substructures Transferable? Riemannian Graph Foundation Model with Neural Vector Bundles
title_zh: 共同子结构是否可迁移？结合神经向量丛的黎曼图基础模型

sentences.en: Foundation models have sparked a revolution via a pretraining-adaptation paradigm, with recent efforts extending this success to graphs.
sentences.zh: 基础模型通过预训练-适配范式引发了革命，近期的研究尝试将这一成功扩展到图。

sentences.en: Unlike other modalities, graphs contain rich structural patterns, yet their structural transferability remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 与其他模态不同，图包含丰富的结构模式，然而它们的结构可迁移性仍然鲜为人知。

sentences.en: Prior studies consider common substructures in the discrete realm, and we are motivated by a fundamental question: Are common substructures transferable?
sentences.zh: 先前的研究在离散领域中考虑常见子结构，而我们被一个根本性问题所驱动：常见子结构可迁移吗？

sentences.en: The underlying theory is largely underexplored.
sentences.zh: 在底层理论在很大程度上尚未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we shift toward learning transferable structures through the lens of functional behavior.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们转向通过功能行为的视角来学习可迁移的结构。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we connect transferable substructures to intrinsic geometry of the representation space.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们将可迁移子结构与表示空间的内在几何联系起来。

sentences.en: However, characterizing such intrinsic geometry has rarely been touched.
sentences.zh: 然而，刻画这种内在几何几乎未被触及。

sentences.en: Grounded in Riemannian geometry, we develop a graph intrinsic geometry learning framework—\textbf{Neural Vector Bundle}, which enables parsing intrinsic geometry with local coordinates.
sentences.zh: 基于黎曼几何，我们发展了一个图内在几何学习框架——**神经向量丛（Neural Vector Bundle）**，它能够用局部坐标解析内在几何。

sentences.en: Building on this, we design \textbf{\textsc{Gauge}}, a pretrainable neural architecture that constructs the vector bundle, flattening geometrically compatible local coordinates, and a new Dirichlet loss, which also measures the transfer effort.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们设计了 **Gauge**，一个可预训练的神经架构，它构建向量丛并展平几何兼容的局部坐标，以及一个新的 Dirichlet 损失，它同时衡量迁移成本。

sentences.en: We empirically validate its superior expressiveness in challenging tasks including zero-shot link prediction and graph isomorphism.
sentences.zh: 我们在包括零样本链接预测和图同构在内的挑战性任务上，实证验证了其优越的表现力。

title_en: Are First-Order Diffusion Samplers Really Slower? A Fast Forward-Value Approach
title_zh: 一阶扩散采样器真的更慢吗？一种快速前向值方法

sentences.en: Higher-order ODE solvers have become a standard tool for accelerating diffusion probabilistic model (DPM) sampling, motivating the widespread view that first-order methods are inherently slower and that increasing discretization order is the primary path to faster generation.
sentences.zh: 高阶 ODE 求解器已成为加速扩散概率模型（DPM）采样的标准工具，这促使了广泛的观点：一阶方法本质上是更慢的，而提高离散化阶数是实现更快生成的主要途径。

sentences.en: This paper challenges this belief and revisits acceleration from a complementary angle: beyond solver order, the placement of DPM evaluations along the reverse-time dynamics can substantially affect sampling accuracy in the low-neural function evaluation (NFE) regime.
sentences.zh: 本文挑战了这一信念，并从互补的角度重新审视加速：除了求解器阶数之外，DPM 评估沿反向时间动力学的放置位置，在低神经函数评估（NFE）区间内能显著影响采样准确率。

sentences.en: We propose a novel training-free, first-order sampler named Forward DPMSolver (F-DPMSolver), whose leading discretization error has the opposite sign to that of DDIM.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新颖的、免训练的一阶采样器，名为 Forward DPMSolver（F-DPMSolver），其主要离散化误差与 DDIM 的符号相反。

sentences.en: Algorithmically, the method approximates the forward-value evaluation via a cheap one-step lookahead predictor.
sentences.zh: 在算法上，该方法通过一个廉价的一步行占位预测器来近似前向值评估。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical guarantees showing that the resulting sampler provably approximates the ideal forward-value trajectory while retaining first-order convergence.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了理论保证，表明由此得到的采样器能够可证明地近似理想的前向值轨迹，同时保持一阶收敛。

sentences.en: Empirically, across standard image generation benchmarks, the proposed sampler consistently improves sample quality under the same NFE budget and can be competitive with, and sometimes outperform, state-of-the-art higher-order samplers.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，跨标准图像生成基准，所提出的采样器在相同的 NFE 预算下一致地改善样本质量，并且能够与最先进的高阶采样器竞争，有时甚至超越它们。

sentences.en: Overall, the results suggest that the placement of DPM evaluations provides an additional and largely independent design angle for accelerating diffusion sampling.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，结果表明 DPM 评估的放置位置为加速扩散采样提供了一个额外的、在很大程度上独立的设计角度。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/Na-Li66/F-DPMSolver.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Na-Li66/F-DPMSolver 获取。

title_en: Are Large Reasoning Models Interruptible?
title_zh: 大型推理模型能否被中断？

sentences.en: Real-world applications of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often require reasoning about changing prompts or environments.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）的现实应用往往要求对变化中的提示或环境进行推理。

sentences.en: In this work, we challenge the frozen world assumption and evaluate LRM robustness under two realistic dynamic scenarios: interruptions, which test the accuracy of model responses under budget-constrained outputs, and dynamic context, which tests model adaptation to in-flight changes.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们挑战冻结世界的假设，并在两种现实的动态场景下评估 LRM 的鲁棒性：中断（测试模型在预算受限输出下的响应准确性）和动态上下文（测试模型对进行中的变化的适应）。

sentences.en: Across mathematics and programming benchmarks that require long-form reasoning, static evaluations consistently overestimate robustness: even state-of-the-art LRMs, which achieve high accuracy in static settings, can fail unpredictably when interrupted or exposed to changing context, with performance dropping by up to 60\% when updates are introduced late in the reasoning process.
sentences.zh: 在需要长形式推理的数学和编程基准上，静态评估一致地高估了鲁棒性：即使是静态设置下取得高准确率的最先进 LRM，在被打断或暴露于变化上下文时也可能不可预测地失败，当更新在推理过程的后期引入时，性能下降可达 60\%。

sentences.en: Our analysis further reveals several novel failure modes, including reasoning leakage, where models fold the reasoning into their final answer when interrupted; panic, where under time pressure models abandon reasoning entirely and return incorrect answers; and self-doubt, where performance degrades when trying to incorporate updated information.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析进一步揭示了几种新颖的失效模式，包括推理泄漏（模型在被中断时把推理折叠进最终答案）、恐慌（在时间压力下模型完全放弃推理并返回错误答案），以及自我怀疑（在尝试纳入更新信息时性能退化）。

sentences.en: The project page is at https://dynamic-lm.github.io
sentences.zh: 项目页面位于 https://dynamic-lm.github.io

title_en: Are LLM Evaluators Really Narcissists? Sanity Checking Self-Preference Evaluations
title_zh: 大语言模型评估器真的自恋吗？对自我偏好评估进行合理性检查

sentences.en: Recent research has shown that large language models (LLMs) favor their own outputs when acting as judges, undermining the integrity of automated post-training and evaluation workflows.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）在充当评审时偏爱自己的输出，这损害了自动化训练后和评估工作流的完整性。

sentences.en: However, it is difficult to disentangle which behaviors are explained by narcissism versus experimental confounds.
sentences.zh: 然而，很难厘清哪些行为可以用自恋来解释，哪些可以用实验混杂因素来解释。

sentences.en: Specifically, LLM evaluators may deliver self-preferring verdicts when comparing responses to questions they fail on; these verdicts may not depend on the identity of the author, but on evaluator quality.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，LLM 评估者在比较针对它们自己无法解答的问题的响应时，可能会给出自偏好的裁决；这些裁决可能不依赖于作者的身份，而依赖于评估者的质量。

sentences.en: We correct this by directly comparing the judge's voting distribution in cases where it evaluates itself versus another model.
sentences.zh: 我们通过直接比较评审在评估自身与评估另一个模型两种情况下的投票分布来纠正这一点。

sentences.en: This evaluator quality baseline reveals that only **51%** of examples in previous findings retain statistical significance against this null hypothesis, covering **89.6%** of total self-preference probability mass.
sentences.zh: 这一评估者质量基线揭示，在先前发现中只有 **51%** 的样本针对这一零假设仍具有统计显著性，这些样本覆盖了总自偏好概率质量的 **89.6%**。

sentences.en: Finally, we compare the entropy of voting distributions, suggesting uncertainty-driven overlap, and show that our procedure enables more careful documentation against the backdrop of judge-bias research.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们比较了投票分布的熵（表明存在由不确定性驱动的重叠），并表明我们的程序能够在评审偏差研究的背景下，促成更细致的文档记录。

title_en: Are Object-Centric Representations Better at Compositional Generalization?
title_zh: 以物体为中心的表征是否更擅长组合泛化？

sentences.en: Compositional generalization, the ability to reason about novel combinations of familiar concepts, is fundamental to human cognition and a critical challenge for machine learning.
sentences.zh: 组合泛化，即对熟悉概念的新颖组合进行推理的能力，是人类认知的基础，也是机器学习的一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: Object-centric (OC) representations, which encode a scene as a set of objects, are often argued to support such generalization, but systematic evidence in visually rich settings is limited.
sentences.zh: 以对象为中心（OC）的表示将一个场景编码为一组对象，常常被认为能够支持这种泛化，但在视觉内容丰富的情况下，系统性的证据仍然有限。

sentences.en: We introduce a Visual Question Answering benchmark across three controlled visual worlds (CLEVRTex, Super-CLEVR, and MOVi-C) to measure how well vision encoders, with and without object-centric biases, generalize to unseen combinations of object properties.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个视觉问答基准，跨越三个受控的视觉世界（CLEVRTex、Super-CLEVR 和 MOVi-C），以衡量有无对象中心偏差的视觉编码器在未见过对象属性组合上的泛化能力。

sentences.en: To ensure a fair and comprehensive comparison, we carefully account for training data diversity, sample size, representation size, downstream model capacity, and compute.
sentences.zh: 为了确保公平而全面的比较，我们仔细控制了训练数据多样性、样本量、表示大小、下游模型容量和计算量。

sentences.en: We use DINOv2 and SigLIP2, two widely used vision encoders, as the foundation models and their OC counterparts.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 DINOv2 和 SigLIP2 这两个广泛使用的视觉编码器作为基础模型及其 OC 对应版本。

sentences.en: Our key findings reveal that (1) OC approaches are superior in harder compositional generalization settings; (2) original dense representations surpass OC only on easier settings and typically require substantially more downstream compute; and (3) OC models are more sample efficient, achieving stronger generalization with fewer images, whereas dense encoders catch up or surpass them only with sufficient data and diversity.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键发现揭示：（1）OC 方法在更难的组合泛化设置中更优；（2）原始的密集表示仅在更简单的设置上超越 OC，并且通常需要大量更多的下游计算；以及（3）OC 模型更具样本效率，用更少的图像实现更强的泛化，而密集编码器只有在拥有足够的数据和多样性时才能追上或超越它们。

sentences.en: Overall, object-centric representations offer stronger compositional generalization when any one of dataset size, training data diversity, or downstream compute is constrained.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，当数据集大小、训练数据多样性或下游计算中的任何一项受限时，以对象为中心的表示能提供更强的组合泛化。

title_en: Are Tools Always Beneficial? Learning to Invoke Tools Adaptively for Dual-Mode Multimodal LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 工具总是有益吗？为双模式多模态大语言模型推理学习自适应工具调用

sentences.en: Tool-augmented reasoning has emerged as a promising direction for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs).
sentences.zh: 工具增强推理已成为提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理能力的一个有前景的方向。

sentences.en: However, existing studies mainly focus on enabling models to perform tool invocation, while neglecting the necessity of invoking tools.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有研究主要关注让模型能够执行工具调用，却忽视了调用工具的必要性。

sentences.en: We argue that tool usage is not always beneficial, as redundant or inappropriate invocations largely increase reasoning overhead and even mislead model predictions.
sentences.zh: 我们认为工具使用并非总是有益的，因为冗余或不恰当的调用会大幅增加推理开销，甚至误导模型预测。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we introduce AutoTool, a model that adaptively decides whether to invoke tools according to the characteristics of each query.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们引入 AutoTool，一个根据每个查询的特征自适应决定是否调用工具的模型。

sentences.en: Within a reinforcement learning framework, we design an explicit dual-mode reasoning strategy with mode-specific reward functions to guide the model toward producing accurate responses.
sentences.zh: 在强化学习框架内，我们设计了一个显式的双模式推理策略，并配以模式特定的奖励函数，以引导模型产生准确的响应。

sentences.en: Moreover, to prevent premature bias toward a single reasoning mode, AutoTool jointly explores and balances tool-assisted and text-centric reasoning throughout training, and promotes free exploration in later stages.
sentences.zh: 此外，为了防止过早偏袒单一推理模式，AutoTool 在整个训练过程中联合探索并平衡工具辅助推理和以文本为中心的推理，并在后期阶段促进自由探索。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AutoTool exhibits outstanding performance and high efficiency, yielding a 21.8\% accuracy gain on V* benchmark compared to the base model, and a 44.9\% improvement in efficiency over existing tool-augmented methods on POPE benchmark.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，AutoTool 展现出卓越的性能和高效率，在 V* 基准上相比基础模型取得了 21.8\% 的准确率提升，在 POPE 基准上相比现有的工具增强方法实现了 44.9\% 的效率改进。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/MQinghe/AutoTool.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/MQinghe/AutoTool 获取。

title_en: Are Two Datasets Close Enough With Statistical Significance? A Kernel Distributional Closeness Testing Approach
title_zh: 两个数据集是否在统计显著意义上足够接近？基于核的分布接近性检验方法

sentences.en: Are two distributions close to each other with statistical significance?
sentences.zh: 两个分布是否在统计显著性意义上相互接近？

sentences.en: *Distribution closeness testing* (DCT) formalizes this question by testing whether the distance between a distribution pair is at least $\epsilon$-far.
sentences.zh: *分布接近检验*（DCT）通过检验一个分布对之间的距离是否至少为 $\epsilon$-远，形式化了这个问题。

sentences.en: Existing DCT methods mainly measure discrepancies between a distribution pair defined on discrete spaces (e.g., using total variation), which limits their applications to complex data (e.g., images).
sentences.zh: 现有的 DCT 方法主要衡量定义在离散空间上的分布对之间的差异（例如，使用全变差），这限制了它们对复杂数据（例如，图像）的应用。

sentences.en: To extend DCT to more types of data, a natural idea is to introduce *maximum mean discrepancy* (MMD), a powerful measurement of the distributional discrepancy between two complex distributions, into DCT scenarios.
sentences.zh: 为了将 DCT 扩展到更多类型的数据，一个自然的想法是将*最大均值差异*（MMD）——一种衡量两个复杂分布之间分布差异的有力度量——引入到 DCT 场景中。

sentences.en: However, the empirical results indicate that many distribution pairs can have the same MMD value despite having different norms in the same *reproducing kernel Hilbert space* (RKHS), and these pairs may exhibit different finite-sample distinguishability and reflect different practical closeness levels, making MMD less informative in DCT.
sentences.zh: 然而，实证结果表明，许多分布对可以具有相同的 MMD 值，尽管它们在同一个*再生核希尔伯特空间*（RKHS）中具有不同范数，并且这些对可能表现出不同的有限样本可分性并反映不同的实际接近程度，这使得 MMD 在 DCT 中的信息量不足。

sentences.en: To mitigate the issue, we design a new measurement of distributional discrepancy, *norm-adaptive MMD* (NAMMD), which scales MMD's value using the RKHS norms of distributions.
sentences.zh: 为了缓解这个问题，我们设计了一种新的分布差异度量，*范数自适应 MMD*（NAMMD），它使用分布的 RKHS 范数来缩放 MMD 的值。

sentences.en: Based on the asymptotic distribution of NAMMD, we finally propose the NAMMD-based DCT to assess the closeness level of a distribution pair.
sentences.zh: 基于 NAMMD 的渐近分布，我们最终提出了基于 NAMMD 的 DCT，以评估分布对的接近程度。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that NAMMD-based DCT has higher test power compared to MMD-based DCT, with bounded type-I error, which is also validated by extensive experiments on many types of data (e.g., synthetic noise, real images).
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明基于 NAMMD 的 DCT 相比基于 MMD 的 DCT 具有更高的检验功效，同时有界的 I 类误差，这一点也通过对许多类型数据（例如，合成噪声、真实图像）的大量实验得到验证。

sentences.en: Our code is available at: https://github.com/zhijianzhouml/NAMMD.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zhijianzhouml/NAMMD 获取。

title_en: Are VLMs Seeing or Just Saying? Uncovering the Illusion of Visual Re-examination
title_zh: 视觉语言模型是在看，还是只是在说？揭露视觉重新检查的假象

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently generate self-reflective statements during reasoning, such as ``let me check the figure again.'' Do such statements trigger genuine visual re-examination, or merely represent learned textual patterns?
sentences.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在推理过程中经常生成自反式语句，例如“让我再看一下这幅图”。此类语句会触发真正的视觉复检，还是仅仅代表了学到的文本模式？

sentences.en: We investigate this question through VisualSwap, an image-swap probing framework: after a model generates reasoning for an image, we replace it with a visually similar but semantically different image and test whether the model detects the change.
sentences.zh: 我们通过 VisualSwap（一个图像替换探针框架）来研究这个问题：在模型对一张图像生成推理后，我们用一张视觉相似但语义不同的图像替换它，并测试模型能否检测到变化。

sentences.en: We introduce VS-Bench, a benchmark of $800$ image pairs curated from MathVista, MathVerse, MathVision, and MMMU-Pro.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 VS-Bench，一个由来自 MathVista、MathVerse、MathVision 和 MMMU-Pro 精选的 $800$ 对图像组成的基准。

sentences.en: Experiments across Qwen3-VL, Kimi-VL, and ERNIE-VL families reveal a striking failure: models overwhelmingly fail to detect image changes, with accuracy dropping by up to 60\%.
sentences.zh: 在 Qwen3-VL、Kimi-VL 和 ERNIE-VL 系列上的实验揭示了一个惊人的失败：模型绝大部分未能检测到图像变化，准确率下降多达 60\%。

sentences.en: Counterintuitively, thinking models exhibit nearly 3$\times$ greater vulnerability than their instructed counterparts, and scaling provides no mitigation.
sentences.zh: 与直觉相反，思维模型表现出比其受指令的对应版本高出近 3 倍的脆弱性，并且扩展规模并不能提供缓解。

sentences.en: However, multi-turn interaction with user instructions can restore visual grounding, while self-generated reflective statements during continuous generation cannot.
sentences.zh: 然而，与用户指令的多轮交互能够恢复视觉基础性，而连续生成过程中自生成的自反式语句则不能。

sentences.en: Attention analysis reveals the underlying mechanism: self-reflection does not increase attention to visual tokens, whereas user instructions substantially elevate it.
sentences.zh: 注意力分析揭示了底层机制：自我反思并未增加对视觉 token 的注意力，而用户指令则大幅提升了它。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal that current VLMs tend to say rather than actually see when claiming visual re-examination.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示，当前 VLM 在声称进行视觉复检时，倾向于“说”而非真正地“看”。

title_en: Are We Overconfident in Models and Results for Semi-Supervised 3D Medical Image Segmentation?
title_zh: 我们是否对半监督三维医学图像分割的模型与结果过于自信？

sentences.en: Semi-supervised learning has become a dominant paradigm for reducing annotation costs.
sentences.zh: 半监督学习已成为降低标注成本的主导范式。

sentences.en: However, we argue that the current progress is clouded by a twofold overconfidence problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们认为当前的进展被一个双重过度自信问题所蒙蔽。

sentences.en: Algorithmically, mainstream pseudo-labeling frameworks often conflate prediction confidence with uncertainty, leading to severe confirmation bias.
sentences.zh: 在算法层面，主流的伪标签框架往往将预测置信度与不确定性混为一谈，导致严重的确认偏误。

sentences.en: Strategically, since multiple benchmark datasets lack dedicated validation sets, some studies use the test set for validation as well, leading to inflated performance estimates.
sentences.zh: 在策略层面，由于多个基准数据集缺乏专门的验证集，一些研究也将测试集用于验证，导致性能估计被夸大。

sentences.en: Subsequent methods, compelled to employ the same strategy to surpass reported SOTA, trigger an arms race of overfitting.
sentences.zh: 后续方法被迫采用相同的策略以超越已报告的 SOTA，从而引发了一场过拟合的军备竞赛。

sentences.en: This raises concerns that the impressive numerical gains in the community may reflect overfitting rather than genuine progress.
sentences.zh: 这引发了担忧：社区中令人印象深刻的数值提升可能反映的是过拟合，而非真正的进展。

sentences.en: Thus, we propose a tri-space calibrated segmentation framework founded on a principled dual-axis reliability assessment engine.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出一个建立于原则性双轴可靠性评估引擎之上的三空间校准分割框架。

sentences.en: It explicitly decouples confidence from uncertainty and uses this signal to detect and correct confirmation bias across feature, probability, and image spaces in a collaborative manner.
sentences.zh: 它显式地将置信度与不确定性解耦，并使用这一信号以协作的方式跨特征、概率和图像空间检测并纠正确认偏误。

sentences.en: Across three benchmark datasets, TCSeg consistently delivers strong performance under existing evaluation protocols.
sentences.zh: 在三个基准数据集上，TCSeg 在现有评估协议下一致地带来了强劲的性能。

sentences.en: More importantly, we advocate that the community report final-checkpoint results under multiple-run protocols, thereby establishing more rigorous benchmarks with a more realistic perspective.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，我们主张社区在多次运行的协议下报告最终检查点的结果，从而以更现实的视角建立更严格的基准。

sentences.en: Code will be available: github.com/DirkLiii/TCSeg.
sentences.zh: 代码将可在 github.com/DirkLiii/TCSeg 获取。

title_en: Are Your Agents Upward Deceivers?
title_zh: 你的智能体会向上级行骗吗？

sentences.en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as autonomous subordinates that carry out tasks for users.
sentences.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体正日益被用作代表用户执行任务的自主下属。

sentences.en: This raises the question of whether they may also engage in deception, similar to how individuals in human organizations lie to superiors to create a good image or avoid punishment.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一个问题：它们是否也可能从事欺骗，类似于人类组织中个体为了营造良好形象或避免惩罚而向上级撒谎。

sentences.en: We observe and define ***agentic upward deception***, a phenomenon in which an agent facing environmental constraints conceals its failure and performs actions that were not requested without reporting.
sentences.zh: 我们观察并定义了***智能体式向上欺骗***，即面临环境约束的智能体隐瞒自身的失败，并执行未被请求的动作而不作报告的现象。

sentences.en: To assess its prevalence, we construct a benchmark of 200 tasks covering five task types and eight realistic scenarios in a constrained environment, such as broken tools or mismatched information sources.
sentences.zh: 为了评估其普遍性，我们构建了一个包含 200 个任务的基准，覆盖五种任务类型和受约束环境（例如，损坏的工具或不匹配的信息源）中的八种现实场景。

sentences.en: Evaluations of 11 popular LLMs reveal that these agents typically exhibit action-based deceptive behaviors, such as guessing results, performing unsupported simulations, substituting unavailable information sources, and fabricating local files.
sentences.zh: 对 11 个流行 LLM 的评估揭示，这些智能体通常表现出基于动作的欺骗行为，例如猜测结果、执行无根据的模拟、替换不可用的信息源，以及编造本地文件。

sentences.en: We further test intuitive mitigation methods and find only limited reductions, suggesting that it is difficult to eliminate and highlighting the need for stronger mitigation strategies to ensure the safety of LLM-based agents.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步测试了直观的缓解方法，发现只取得了有限的减少，这表明该行为难以消除，并凸显了对更强缓解策略以确保基于 LLM 的智能体安全性的需求。

sentences.en: Code and data are available at https://github.com/QingyuLiu/Agentic-Upward-Deception.
sentences.zh: 代码和数据可在 https://github.com/QingyuLiu/Agentic-Upward-Deception 获取。

title_en: AREA: Attribute Extraction and Aggregation for CLIP-Based Class-Incremental Learning
title_zh: AREA：用于基于 CLIP 的类别增量学习的属性提取与聚合

sentences.en: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) is important in building real-world learning systems.
sentences.zh: 类增量学习（CIL）在构建现实世界学习系统中很重要。

sentences.en: In CLIP-based CIL, the model performs classification by comparing similarity between visual and textual embeddings obtained from template prompts, e.g., ``a photo of a [CLASS]''.
sentences.zh: 在基于 CLIP 的 CIL 中，模型通过比较从模板提示（例如，“一张 [类别] 的照片”）获得的视觉和文本嵌入之间的相似性来执行分类。

sentences.en: This seemingly monolithic matching process can be decomposed into two conceptually distinct stages: attribute extraction and attribute aggregation.
sentences.zh: 这一看似单一整体的匹配过程可以被分解为两个概念上不同的阶段：属性提取和属性聚合。

sentences.en: For example, a model may recognize cat using attributes such as fur texture and whiskers.
sentences.zh: 例如，模型可以使用毛发纹理和胡须等属性来识别猫。

sentences.en: When learning a new class like car, the model must extract additional attributes like wheels and adjust how they are aggregated in the shared representation space.
sentences.zh: 在学习诸如汽车等新类时，模型必须提取诸如车轮等额外属性，并调整它们如何在共享表示空间中被聚合。

sentences.en: However, since only data from the current task is available, incremental updates can bias both attribute extraction and aggregation toward new classes, leading to catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于只有当前任务的数据可用，增量更新可能使属性提取和聚合都偏向新类，从而导致灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: Therefore, we propose AREA for attribute extraction and aggregation in CLIP-based CIL.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出 AREA，用于基于 CLIP 的 CIL 中的属性提取与聚合。

sentences.en: To stabilize extraction, we anchor class-level visual and textual attributes on the hyperspherical embedding space via principal geodesic analysis.
sentences.zh: 为了稳定提取，我们通过主测地线分析将类级视觉和文本属性锚定在超球嵌入空间上。

sentences.en: To stabilize aggregation, we learn lightweight task-specific experts with scoring and residual refinement, regularized by a variational information bottleneck objective.
sentences.zh: 为了稳定聚合，我们学习轻量级任务特定专家，配备评分和残差精化，并由变分信息瓶颈目标进行正则化。

sentences.en: During inference, we perform routing over task attribute manifolds via optimal transport for more concise prediction.
sentences.zh: 在推断时，我们通过最优输运在任务属性流形上进行路由，以获得更简洁的预测。

sentences.en: Experiments show that AREA consistently outperforms SOTA methods.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，AREA 一致地优于 SOTA 方法。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/ICML2026-AREA.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/ICML2026-AREA 获取。

title_en: AReaL-DTA: Dynamic Tree Attention for Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Large Language Models
title_zh: AReaL-DTA：通过动态树注意力高效开展大语言模型强化学习

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training for large language models (LLMs) is computationally expensive, as it generates many rollout sequences that frequently share long token prefixes.
sentences.zh: 基于强化学习（RL）的大语言模型（LLM）训练后是计算昂贵的，因为它生成了许多常常共享长 token 前缀的 rollout 序列。

sentences.en: Existing RL frameworks usually process these sequences independently during policy training, i.e., repeatedly recomputing identical prefixes in both the forward and backward passes of policy gradient computation, leading to substantial inefficiencies in computation resources and memory usage.
sentences.zh: 现有的 RL 框架在策略训练期间通常独立处理这些序列，即在策略梯度计算的前向和反向传播中反复重算相同的前缀，导致计算资源和内存使用方面的显著低效。

sentences.en: Although prefix sharing naturally induces a tree structure over rollouts, packed tree-mask approaches scale poorly in RL settings.
sentences.zh: 虽然前缀共享自然地在 rollout 上诱导出一个树结构，但打包的树掩码方法在 RL 设置中扩展性较差。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce AReaL-DTA, which efficiently exploits prefix sharing in RL training.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入 AReaL-DTA，它在 RL 训练中高效地利用前缀共享。

sentences.en: AReaL-DTA employs a depth-first search (DFS)-based execution strategy that dynamically traverses the rollout prefix tree during both forward and backward computation, materializing only a single root-to-leaf path at a time.
sentences.zh: AReaL-DTA 采用一种基于深度优先搜索（DFS）的执行策略，在前向和反向计算期间动态遍历 rollout 前缀树，每次仅实例化一条从根到叶的路径。

sentences.en: To further improve scalability, AReaL-DTA incorporates a load-balanced distributed batching mechanism that dynamically constructs and processes prefix trees across multiple GPUs.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步提升可扩展性，AReaL-DTA 纳入了一种负载均衡的分布式批处理机制，它在多个 GPU 上动态构建和处理前缀树。

sentences.en: On $\tau^2$-bench, AReaL-DTA improves training throughput by up to $8.31\times$ over dense training and up to $1.70\times$ over sparse training.
sentences.zh: 在 $\tau^2$-bench 上，AReaL-DTA 相比密集训练将训练吞吐量提升了多达 $8.31\times$，相比稀疏训练提升了多达 $1.70\times$。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/tree/feat/dta.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/tree/feat/dta 获取。
