title_en: Attention Sinks in Diffusion Transformers: A Causal Analysis
title_zh: 扩散 Transformer 中的注意力汇聚点：因果分析

sentences.en: Attention sinks---tokens that receive disproportionate attention mass---are  assumed to be functionally important in autoregressive language models, but  their role in diffusion transformers remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 注意力汇——接收不成比例注意力质量的 token ——在自回归语言模型中被认为具有重要的功能作用，但它们在扩散 Transformer 中的作用仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We present a causal analysis in text-to-image diffusion, dynamically identifying  dominant attention recipients per timestep and suppressing them via paired,  training-free interventions on the score and value paths.
sentences.zh: 我们在文本到图像扩散中提出一种因果分析，动态识别每个时间步的主导注意力接收者，并通过在分数和值路径上进行配对的、免训练的干预来抑制它们。

sentences.en: Across 553 GenEval prompts on Stable Diffusion~3 (with SDXL corroboration),  removing these sinks does not degrade text-image alignment (CLIP-T) or  preference proxies (ImageReward, HPS-v2) at $k{=}1$; only under stronger  interventions ($k\!\geq\!10$) does HPS-v2 exhibit a metric-dependent boundary,  while CLIP-T remains robust throughout.
sentences.zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 3 上的 553 个 GenEval 提示（并有 SDXL 佐证）中，在 $k{=}1$ 时移除这些汇并不会降低文本-图像对齐（CLIP-T）或偏好代理（ImageReward、HPS-v2）；只有在更强的干预（$k\!\geq\!10$）下，HPS-v2 才表现出一个依赖度量的边界，而 CLIP-T 在整个过程中保持稳健。

sentences.en: The perceptual shifts induced by suppression are nonetheless  \emph{sink-specific}---$\sim\!6\times$ larger than equal-budget random  masking---revealing an empirical dissociation between trajectory-level  perturbation and \emph{semantic alignment} in diffusion transformers.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，由抑制引起的感知偏移是*汇特定的*——比等预算的随机掩码大约 6 倍——揭示了扩散 Transformer 中轨迹级扰动与*语义对齐*之间经验性的分离。

sentences.en: \footnote{Code  available at \url{https://github.com/wfz666/ICML26-attention-sink}.}
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/wfz666/ICML26-attention-sink 获取。

title_en: Attention Sparsity is Input-Stable: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Video Generation via Offline Sparsity Profiling and Online QK Co-Clustering
title_zh: 注意力稀疏性对输入保持稳定：通过离线稀疏性分析与在线 QK 协同聚类实现无需训练的视频生成稀疏注意力

sentences.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve strong video generation quality but suffer from high inference cost due to dense 3D attention, leading to the development of sparse attention technologies to improve efficiency.
sentences.zh: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）实现了强大的视频生成质量，但因密集的 3D 注意力而遭受高推断成本，这推动了稀疏注意力技术的发展以提高效率。

sentences.en: However, existing training-free sparse attention methods in video generation still face two unresolved limitations: *ignoring layer heterogeneity in attention pruning* and *ignoring query-key coupling in block partitioning*, which hinder a better quality-speedup trade-off.
sentences.zh: 然而，视频生成中现有的免训练稀疏注意力方法仍面临两个未解决的局限：*在注意力剪枝中忽略层异质性*和*在块分区中忽略查询-键耦合*，它们阻碍了更好的质量-加速权衡。

sentences.en: In this work, we uncover a critical insight that **the attention sparsity of each layer is its intrinsic property, with minor effects across different inputs**.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们揭示了一个关键洞见：**每层的注意力稀疏性是它的内在属性，对不同输入的影响很小**。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose **SVOO**, a training-free **S**parse attention framework for fast **V**ideo generation via **O**ffline layer-wise sparsity profiling and **O**nline bidirectional co-clustering.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出 **SVOO**，一个通过离线逐层稀疏性分析和在线双向协同聚类，实现快速视频生成的免训练**稀疏注意力（Sparse attention）**框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, SVOO adopts a two-stage paradigm: (i) offline layer-wise sensitivity profiling to derive intrinsic per-layer pruning levels, and (ii) online block-wise sparse attention via a novel bidirectional co-clustering algorithm.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，SVOO 采用两阶段范式：（i）离线逐层敏感性分析以推导内在的逐层剪枝水平，以及（ii）通过一种新颖的双向协同聚类算法实现在线逐块稀疏注意力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on seven widely used video generation models demonstrate that SVOO achieves a superior quality-speedup trade-off over state-of-the-art methods, delivering up to 1.93× speedup while maintaining a PSNR of up to 29 dB on Wan2.1.
sentences.zh: 在七个广泛使用的视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，SVOO 相比最先进的方法实现了更优的质量-加速权衡，在 Wan2.1 上实现多达 1.93 倍的加速，同时将 PSNR 保持在高至 29 dB。

title_en: Attention with Routed-Memory for Learnable Sparse Control
title_zh: 结合路由记忆的注意力：实现可学习的稀疏控制

sentences.en: Despite advances in long-context inference, large language models (LLMs) remain fundamentally limited by the key-value (KV) caching mechanisms that are necessary for stable computation.
sentences.zh: 尽管长上下文推断取得了进展，但大语言模型（LLM）仍然从根本上受限于稳定计算所必需的键值（KV）缓存机制。

sentences.en: Techniques such as selective token eviction and pruning have vastly mitigated these issues, but often discard core information to manage the growing cache.
sentences.zh: 诸如选择性 token 驱逐和剪枝等技术极大地缓解了这些问题，但往往为了管理不断增长的缓存而丢弃核心信息。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose _**A**ttention with **R**outed **M**emory_ (_**ARM**_) a novel KV caching structure that introduces a fully differentiable, fixed-size memory system organized as a hierarchical router.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 *带路由记忆的注意力（Attention with Routed Memory，ARM）*，一种新颖的 KV 缓存结构，它引入了一个完全可微、固定大小的记忆系统，组织为一个层级路由器。

sentences.en: Via a Gumbel-Softmax, _**ARM**_ learns to select memory slots and perform sigmoid-gated updates that softly combine new and stored information, avoiding hard eviction and reducing information loss.
sentences.zh: 通过 Gumbel-Softmax，ARM 学习选择记忆槽并执行 sigmoid 门控更新，柔和地组合新信息与已存储信息，避免硬驱逐并减少信息损失。

sentences.en: By further training a policy to dynamically select varying amounts of memory at inference, _**ARM**_ adapts its accesses for both simple contexts and inputs that require deeper reasoning, enabling more scalable and effective retrieval on both short- and long-contexts.
sentences.zh: 通过进一步训练一个策略，在推断时动态选择不同数量的记忆，ARM 为简单上下文和需要更深推理的输入都自适应其访问，从而在短上下文和长上下文上实现更可扩展、更有效的检索。

sentences.en: Experimental results on standard commonsense and long-context reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that _**ARM**_ achieves superior performance and efficiency compared to fixed KV-caching approaches, while remaining efficient and scalable in terms of both memory and generation latency.
sentences.zh: 在标准常识推理和长上下文推理基准上的实验结果表明，ARM 相比固定的 KV 缓存方法取得了优越的性能和效率，同时在内存和生成延迟方面保持高效且可扩展。

title_en: Attention's forward pass and Frank-Wolfe
title_zh: 注意力的前向传播与 Frank–Wolfe 算法

sentences.en: We analyze the hardmax limit of self-attention dynamics for token embeddings in the zero-temperature regime $(\beta \to +\infty)$ and relate it to finite-$\beta$ behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们分析零温度区间 $(\beta \to +\infty)$ 中 token 嵌入自注意力动态的 hardmax 极限，并将其与有限 $\beta$ 行为联系起来。

sentences.en: In this limit, the update rule can be viewed as a Frank-Wolfe step for a quadratic objective over the convex hull of the current tokens.
sentences.zh: 在该极限下，更新规则可以被视为对当前 token 凸包上一次二次目标的一个 Frank-Wolfe 步。

sentences.en: When the key-query matrix is negative semidefinite, the dynamics converge with the standard sublinear rate $\mathcal{O}(t^{-1})$ on the quadratic energy, whereas in the positive semidefinite case, extending the hardmax rule to the convex hull induces a Voronoi structure: vertices are stationary, interior points remain in their initial cells, and each token moves along a straight line toward its cell's vertex with exponential convergence under a step-size bounded away from zero.
sentences.zh: 当键-查询矩阵是负半定时，动态以标准次线性速率 $\mathcal{O}(t^{-1})$ 收敛到二次能量上；而在正半定情形下，将 hardmax 规则推广到凸包会诱导出一种 Voronoi 结构：顶点是平稳的，内部点停留在其初始单元内，每个 token 沿直线朝其单元顶点移动，并在远离零的步长下以指数收敛。

sentences.en: We additionally establish well-posedness of the associated ODE limit in this regime.
sentences.zh: 我们还确立了该区间中相应 ODE 极限的适定性。

sentences.en: For finite $\beta$, we model self-attention as a Markov chain and prove *dynamic metastability*: interior tokens reach near-vertex configurations in a constant number of steps and remain trapped for times exponential in $\beta$ with high probability, before eventual collapse to some point within the initial convex hull.
sentences.zh: 对于有限 $\beta$，我们将自注意力建模为马尔可夫链，并证明*动态亚稳定性*：内部 token 在常数步数内达到近顶点配置，并以高概率被困在 $\beta$ 的指数级时间尺度内，之后最终坍缩到初始凸包内的某一点。

sentences.en: Thus, hardmax dynamics accurately approximate the finite-$\beta$ process over exponentially long time horizons.
sentences.zh: 因此，hardmax 动态在指数级长的时间跨度内精确逼近有限 $\beta$ 过程。

title_en: Attentive Multi-Layer Fusion for Vision Transformers
title_zh: 视觉 Transformer 的注意力式多层融合

sentences.en: With the rise of large-scale foundation models, efficiently adapting them to downstream tasks remains a central challenge.
sentences.zh: 随着大规模基础模型的兴起，将它们高效地适配到下游任务仍然是一个核心挑战。

sentences.en: Linear probing, which freezes the backbone and trains a lightweight head, is computationally efficient but often restricted to last-layer representations.
sentences.zh: 线性探测（Linear probing）冻结骨干并训练轻量级头，计算上高效，但往往局限于最后一层的表示。

sentences.en: We show that task-relevant information is distributed across the network hierarchy rather than encoded solely in the last layers.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，与任务相关的信息分布在整个网络层级中，而非只编码在最后几层。

sentences.en: To leverage this distribution of information, we apply an attentive probing mechanism that dynamically fuses representations from all layers of a Vision Transformer.
sentences.zh: 为了利用这种信息分布，我们应用一种注意力探测机制，它动态地融合视觉 Transformer 所有层的表示。

sentences.en: This attentive layer fusion (ALF) learns to identify the most relevant layers for a target task and combines low-level structural cues with high-level semantic abstractions.
sentences.zh: 这种注意力层融合（ALF）学会识别目标任务最相关的层，并组合低层结构线索与高层语义抽象。

sentences.en: Across 20 diverse datasets and multiple pretrained foundation models, ALF achieves consistent, substantial gains over standard linear probes.
sentences.zh: 在 20 个多样化的数据集和多个预训练基础模型上，ALF 相对于标准线性探测取得了一致、可观的提升。

sentences.en: Attention heatmaps further reveal that tasks different from the pre-training domain benefit most from intermediate representations.
sentences.zh: 注意力热图进一步揭示，与预训练领域不同的任务最受益于中间表示。

sentences.en: Overall, our findings underscore the value of intermediate layers and demonstrate a principled, task-aware approach for unlocking their potential for probing-based adaptation.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我们的发现强调了中间层的价值，并展示了一种有原则、任务感知的方法，以释放它们在基于探测的适配中的潜力。

title_en: Attn-QAT: 4-Bit Attention With Quantization-Aware Training
title_zh: Attn-QAT：利用量化感知训练实现 4 比特注意力

sentences.en: Achieving reliable 4-bit attention is a prerequisite for end-to-end FP4 computation on emerging FP4-capable GPUs,  yet attention remains the main obstacle due to FP4's tiny dynamic range and attention's heavy-tailed activations.
sentences.zh: 实现可靠的 4 位注意力，是在新兴的 FP4 兼容 GPU 上进行端到端 FP4 计算的前提，然而由于 FP4 的极小动态范围和注意力的重尾激活，注意力仍然是主要障碍。

sentences.en: This paper presents the first systematic study of 4-bit quantization-aware training (QAT) for attention.
sentences.zh: 本文呈现了针对注意力的 4 位量化感知训练（QAT）的首次系统性研究。

sentences.en: We find ``drop-in'' QAT -- naively combining an FP4 forward pass with high-precision Flash Attention (FA)-style backward pass -- leads to training instability.
sentences.zh: 我们发现"直接替换"的 QAT——将 FP4 前向传播与高精度 Flash Attention（FA）风格的反向传播朴素地组合——会导致训练不稳定。

sentences.en: We identify two key principles for stable FP4 attention: (1) matching low-precision recomputation of attention scores in the backward pass and (2) resolving implicit precision assumptions in FA’s gradient calculation.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出用于稳定 FP4 注意力的两个关键原则：（1）在反向传播中匹配注意力分数的低精度重计算；以及（2）解决 FA 梯度计算中的隐式精度假设。

sentences.en: Based on these insights, we propose Attn-QAT and implement fused Triton kernels for training plus FP4 inference kernels.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞见，我们提出 Attn-QAT，并实现了用于训练的融合 Triton 核以及 FP4 推断核。

sentences.en: Across diffusion and  language models, Attn-QAT recovers the quality drop from FP4 attention without  explicit outlier-mitigation heuristics used in prior FP4 attention, and delivers up to a 1.5x speedup on an RTX 5090.
sentences.zh: 在扩散模型和语言模型上，Attn-QAT 无需先前 FP4 注意力所用的显式离群点缓解启发式，即可恢复 FP4 注意力的质量损失，并在 RTX 5090 上实现多达 1.5 倍的加速。

title_en: Attributed Network Alignment: Statistical Limits and Efficient Algorithm
title_zh: 带属性网络对齐：统计极限与高效算法

sentences.en: This paper studies the problem of recovering a hidden vertex correspondence between two correlated graphs when both edge weights and node features are observed.
sentences.zh: 本文研究在两个相关图的边权和节点特征都被观测到时，恢复它们之间隐藏顶点对应关系的问题。

sentences.en: While most existing work on graph alignment relies primarily on edge information, many real-world applications provide informative node features in addition to graph topology.
sentences.zh: 虽然大多数现有的图对齐工作主要依赖边信息，但许多现实应用除了图拓扑之外还提供了信息丰富的节点特征。

sentences.en: To capture this setting, we introduce the featured correlated Gaussian Wigner model, where two graphs are coupled through an unknown vertex permutation, and the node features are correlated under the same permutation.
sentences.zh: 为了捕捉这一设置，我们引入带属性的相关高斯 Wigner 模型，其中两个图通过一个未知的顶点置换耦合，且节点特征在相同的置换下相关。

sentences.en: We characterize the optimal information-theoretic thresholds for exact recovery and partial recovery of the latent mapping.
sentences.zh: 我们刻画了潜在映射精确恢复和部分恢复的最优信息论阈值。

sentences.en: On the algorithmic side, we propose QPAlign, an efficient method based on a quadratic programming relaxation, and demonstrate its strong empirical performance on both synthetic and real datasets.
sentences.zh: 在算法方面，我们提出 QPAlign，一种基于二次规划松弛的高效方法，并在合成和真实数据集上展示了其强劲的实证性能。

sentences.en: Moreover, we also derive theoretical guarantees for the proposed procedure, supporting its reliability and providing convergence guarantees.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还为所提出的过程推导了理论保证，支持其可靠性并提供收敛保证。

title_en: Attribution-Guided and Coverage-Maximized Pruning for Structural MoE Compression
title_zh: 用于结构化 MoE 压缩的归因引导与覆盖最大化剪枝

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale compute efficiently, yet they remain expensive to deploy due to substantial memory footprint and inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 混合专家（MoE）模型在计算上高效扩展，但由于可观的内存占用和推断开销，它们仍然部署成本高昂。

sentences.en: Prior methods mainly operate at the expert level, either removing whole experts or ranking experts by importance.
sentences.zh: 先前的方法主要在专家层面上运作，要么移除整个专家，要么按重要性对专家排序。

sentences.en: However, such expert-wise decisions are too coarse to identify redundancy, and often misallocate pruning budgets and limits compression.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种逐专家的决策过于粗略，无法识别冗余，并且常常错误分配剪枝预算并限制压缩。

sentences.en: This issue worsens in large MoEs with dynamic routing and heterogeneous experts.
sentences.zh: 在具有动态路由和异构专家的大型 MoE 中，这个问题会加剧。

sentences.en: To alleviate this dilemma, we for the first time observe that information in MoE experts is highly concentrated in a few channels, leaving substantial redundancy even in "high importance" experts.
sentences.zh: 为了缓解这一困境，我们首次观察到，MoE 专家中的信息高度集中在少数通道中，即使在"高重要性"专家中也留有大量冗余。

sentences.en: Accordingly, we propose a structural pruning framework tailored for MoEs, reforming the prune-ratio objective to maximizing channel-score coverage via an efficient attribution-based approximation.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出一个专门针对 MoE 的结构剪枝框架，通过一种高效的基于归因的近似，将剪枝率目标改造为最大化通道分数覆盖。

sentences.en: Experiments on DeepSeek and Qwen MoEs retain accuracy under 50\% or 25\% pruning joinly with 4-bit quantization, reducing the memory footprint of Qwen3-30B-A3B by 5.27$\times$, and outperforming state-of-the-art baselines under diverse benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在 DeepSeek 和 Qwen MoE 上的实验表明，在 50\% 或 25\% 剪枝与 4 位量化相结合的设置下保持了准确率，将 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的内存占用降低了 5.27 倍，并在多样化的基准上优于最先进的基线。

title_en: AudioChat: Unified Audio Storytelling, Editing, and Understanding with Transfusion Forcing
title_zh: AudioChat：利用 Transfusion Forcing 统一音频叙事、编辑与理解

sentences.en: Despite recent breakthroughs, audio foundation models struggle in processing complex multi-source acoustic scenes.
sentences.zh: 尽管近期取得了突破，但音频基础模型在处理复杂多源声学场景方面仍然困难重重。

sentences.en: We refer to this challenging domain as audio stories, which can have multiple speakers and background/foreground sound effects.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一具有挑战性的领域称为音频故事，它可以有多个说话者以及背景/前景音效。

sentences.en: Compared to traditional audio processing tasks, audio stories introduce new layers of semantic, temporal, and physical complexity.
sentences.zh: 与传统的音频处理任务相比，音频故事引入了新的语义、时间和物理复杂度层次。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose AudioChat, a framework for developing audio foundation models that can generate, edit, and understand audio stories.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一挑战，我们提出 AudioChat，一个用于开发能够生成、编辑和理解音频故事的音频基础模型的框架。

sentences.en: AudioChat introduces a new paradigm in which LLM-based toolcalling agents simulate interactions between users and the system, and these simulated dialogues are used as training data.
sentences.zh: AudioChat 引入了一种新范式，其中基于 LLM 的工具调用智能体模拟用户与系统之间的交互，而这些模拟对话被用作训练数据。

sentences.en: We also introduce a novel Audio Transfusion Forcing objective to train the AudioChat model, allowing it to simultaneously decompose high-level instructions via structured chain-of-thought reasoning and perform interactive multi-turn audio understanding/generation.
sentences.zh: 我们还引入了一个新颖的音频 Transfusion Forcing 目标来训练 AudioChat 模型，使其能够通过结构化思维链推理同时分解高级指令，并执行交互式多轮音频理解/生成。

sentences.en: To evaluate generation and editing performance, we develop three new metrics that directly measure task performance instead of relying upon distribution-based scoring.
sentences.zh: 为了评估生成和编辑性能，我们开发了三个直接衡量任务性能而非依赖基于分布评分的新指标。

sentences.en: We highly encourage readers to visit our demo to better understand the capabilities of AudioChat: https://audiochat-icml-2026.github.io/.
sentences.zh: 我们强烈鼓励读者访问我们的演示以更好地理解 AudioChat 的能力：https://audiochat-icml-2026.github.io/。

title_en: AudioMosaic: Contrastive Masked Audio Representation Learning
title_zh: AudioMosaic：对比式掩码音频表征学习

sentences.en: Audio self-supervised learning (SSL) aims to learn general-purpose representations from large-scale unlabeled audio data and has achieved remarkable progress in recent years.
sentences.zh: 音频自监督学习（SSL）旨在从大规模未标注音频数据中学习通用表示，近年来取得了显著进展。

sentences.en: While most prior work relies on generative reconstruction objectives, contrastive approaches remain relatively underexplored, in part due to the high computational cost of designing effective augmentation strategies and the large batch sizes typically required for pre-training.
sentences.zh: 虽然大部分先前的工作依赖生成式重建目标，但对比方法仍然相对未被充分探索，部分原因是设计有效增强策略的计算成本高昂，以及预训练通常需要的大批量。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce **AudioMosaic**, an audio encoder for general audio understanding.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入 **AudioMosaic**，一个用于通用音频理解的音频编码器。

sentences.en: During pre-training, AudioMosaic applies time–frequency masking to spectrogram patches to form paired inputs, employing an elegant and efficient augmentation strategy that significantly reduces computational cost while supporting large-batch training.
sentences.zh: 在预训练期间，AudioMosaic 对声谱图块应用时频掩码以形成配对输入，采用一种优雅且高效的增强策略，显著降低计算成本，同时支持大批量训练。

sentences.en: The AudioMosaic encoder learns discriminative utterance-level representations that exhibit strong transferability across datasets, domains, and acoustic conditions.
sentences.zh: AudioMosaic 编码器学习到具有判别性的话语级表示，这些表示在数据集、领域和声学条件之间展现出强大的可迁移性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AudioMosaic achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple standard benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，AudioMosaic 在多个标准基准上取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Moreover, we show that the pretrained AudioMosaic encoder enhances audio perception when integrated with large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明，预训练的 AudioMosaic 编码器在与大语言模型（LLM）集成时能够增强音频感知。

title_en: Auditing Sybil: Explaining Deep Lung Cancer Risk Prediction Through Generative Interventional Attributions
title_zh: 审计 Sybil：通过生成式干预归因解释深度肺癌风险预测

sentences.en: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer mortality, driving the development of automated screening tools to alleviate radiologist workload.
sentences.zh: 肺癌仍然是癌症死亡的主要原因，推动着自动化筛查工具的发展以减轻放射科医生的工作负担。

sentences.en: Standing at the frontier of this effort is Sybil, a deep learning model capable of predicting future risk solely from computed tomography (CT) with high precision.
sentences.zh: 站在这一努力前沿的是 Sybil，一个能够仅从计算机断层扫描（CT）高精度预测未来风险的深度学习模型。

sentences.en: However, despite extensive clinical validation, current assessments rely purely on observational metrics.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管经过了广泛的临床验证，当前的评估仍纯粹依赖观察性指标。

sentences.en: This correlation-based approach overlooks the model's actual reasoning mechanism, necessitating a shift to causal verification to ensure robust decision-making before clinical deployment.
sentences.zh: 这种基于相关性的方法忽视了模型的实际推理机制，需要在临床部署前转向因果验证，以确保稳健的决策。

sentences.en: We propose S(H)NAP, a model-agnostic auditing framework that constructs generative interventional attributions validated by expert radiologists.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 S(H)NAP，一个模型无关的审计框架，它构建由专家放射科医生验证的生成式干预归因。

sentences.en: By leveraging realistic 3D diffusion bridge modeling to systematically modify anatomical features, our approach isolates object-specific causal contributions to the risk score.
sentences.zh: 通过利用逼真的 3D 扩散桥建模来系统性地修改解剖特征，我们的方法隔离出目标特定因果贡献对风险分数的影响。

sentences.en: Providing the first interventional audit of Sybil, we demonstrate that while the model often exhibits behavior akin to an expert radiologist, differentiating malignant pulmonary nodules from benign ones, it suffers from critical failure modes, including dangerous sensitivity to clinically unjustified artifacts and a distinct radial bias.
sentences.zh: 提供对 Sybil 的首次干预审计，我们表明，尽管该模型常常表现出类似专家放射科医生的行为（区分恶性肺结节与良性结节），但它存在关键失效模式，包括对临床上不合理的伪影的危险敏感性，以及一种明显的放射状偏差。

title_en: AugMask: Training Diffusion Models on Incomplete Tabular Data via Stochastic Augmentation and Masking
title_zh: AugMask：通过随机增强与掩码在不完整表格数据上训练扩散模型

sentences.en: Score-based diffusion models have emerged as prominent deep generative models; however, their application to tabular data remains challenging because their backbones assume fully specified inputs, whereas real-world tabular data often contain missing values.
sentences.zh: 基于分数的扩散模型已成为突出的深度生成模型；然而，它们对表格数据的应用仍然具有挑战性，因为它们的骨干假设输入是完整指定的，而现实世界的表格数据往往包含缺失值。

sentences.en: We propose **AugMask**, a plug-and-play training framework that adapts missing-unaware backbones to incomplete data via stochastic regularization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **AugMask**，一个即插即用的训练框架，它通过随机正则化使对缺失不感知的骨干适配到不完整数据。

sentences.en: AugMask 1) completes inputs via *conditional stochastic augmentation* using lightweight auxiliary models and 2) masks the loss, using augmented missing entries for conditioning while restricting supervision to observed coordinates.
sentences.zh: AugMask 1）通过使用轻量级辅助模型的*条件随机增强*来补全输入；以及 2）掩码损失，使用增强的缺失条目进行条件设定，同时将监督限制在观测到的坐标上。

sentences.en: We connect AugMask to a Rao-Blackwellized objective and show that marginalizing missing entries yields a variance-weighted sensitivity penalty, promoting invariance of observed-coordinate reconstruction with respect to uncertain missing entries.
sentences.zh: 我们将 AugMask 与一个 Rao-Blackwellized 目标联系起来，并表明对缺失条目进行边缘化会产生一个方差加权的敏感性惩罚，促进观测坐标重构对不确定性缺失条目的不变性。

sentences.en: Across diverse datasets and missingness regimes, AugMask enables standard diffusion-based tabular generators to match or outperform specialized missing-aware baselines in both sample fidelity and downstream utility.
sentences.zh: 在多样化的数据集和缺失情形下，AugMask 使标准的基于扩散的表格生成器在样本保真度和下游效用方面能够匹配或超越专门的、对缺失感知的基线。

sentences.en: The code will be released.
sentences.zh: 代码将发布。

title_en: AugServe: Adaptive Request Scheduling for Augmented Large Language Model Inference Serving
title_zh: AugServe：增强型大语言模型推理服务的自适应请求调度

sentences.en: Augmented large language models (LLMs) that invoke external calls are increasingly prevalent in inference serving.
sentences.zh: 调用外部调用的增强型大语言模型（LLM）在推断服务中日益普遍。

sentences.en: However, such augmentations pose significant challenges to inference efficiency under strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs).
sentences.zh: 然而，此类增强在严格的服务级目标（SLO）下对推断效率构成了重大挑战。

sentences.en: Existing inference systems are agnostic to the dynamic execution behaviors induced by external calls and rely on fixed batch-level token budget, which leads to severe Head-of-Line (HoL) blocking and substantially reduced effective throughput.
sentences.zh: 现有的推断系统对外部调用引起的动态执行行为不敏感，并依赖固定的批级 token 预算，这导致严重的首行（HoL）阻塞，并大幅降低有效吞吐量。

sentences.en: We present AugServe, an efficient augmented LLM inference serving framework that mitigates request queuing latency and improves effective throughput under external-call-augmented workloads.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 AugServe，一个高效的增强 LLM 推断服务框架，它减轻了请求排队延迟，并在外部调用增强的工作负载下提高了有效吞吐量。

sentences.en: AugServe integrates state-aware request scheduling with dynamic batch-level token budgets to adapt to heterogeneous requests and their dynamically changing execution states.
sentences.zh: AugServe 将状态感知的请求调度与动态批级 token 预算相结合，以适应异构请求及其动态变化的执行状态。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that AugServe achieves 6.5$\times$ and 4.7$\times$ higher effective throughput than vLLM and INFERCEPT, respectively.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，AugServe 的有效吞吐量分别是 vLLM 和 INFERCEPT 的 6.5 倍和 4.7 倍。

title_en: AURA: Visually Interpretable Affective Understanding via Robust Archetypes
title_zh: AURA：通过鲁棒原型实现视觉可解释的情感理解

sentences.en: Interpretable methods such as vision--language models (VLMs) have advanced affect analysis by aligning images with textual descriptions.
sentences.zh: 诸如视觉-语言模型（VLM）等可解释方法通过将图像与文本描述对齐，推进了情感分析。

sentences.en: However, relying on text as an intermediate proxy faces critical limitations: linguistic templates are inherently discrete, making them fundamentally incompatible with continuous valence--arousal regression, while also acting as a bottleneck for fine-grained visual nuances.
sentences.zh: 然而，将文本作为中间代理面临关键局限：语言模板本质上是离散的，使它们与连续的效价-唤起回归从根本上不兼容，同时它们也成为细粒度视觉细节的瓶颈。

sentences.en: Cognitive psychology suggests that human affective perception is not mediated by linguistic translation, but is grounded in perceptual resemblance to internalized visual archetypes.
sentences.zh: 认知心理学表明，人类情感感知并非由语言转译所中介，而是建立在与内化视觉原型的知觉相似性之上。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose AURA, an archetype-based framework that replaces brittle linguistic proxies with a self-organizing archetype manifold.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出 AURA，一个基于原型的框架，它用自组织的原型流形取代脆弱的语言代理。

sentences.en: By adaptively allocating representational density according to affective complexity, AURA enables accurate continuous regression and reshapes affective taxonomies by decomposing labels into interpretable, geometrically coherent visual primitives.
sentences.zh: 通过根据情感复杂度自适应地分配表示密度，AURA 实现了准确的连续回归，并通过将标签分解为可解释、几何连贯的视觉原语来重塑情感分类体系。

sentences.en: This paradigm offers a transparent, visually grounded decision trail and achieves state-of-the-art results across discrete and continuous tasks.
sentences.zh: 这一范式提供了一条透明、视觉扎根的决策轨迹，并在离散和连续任务上取得了最先进的结果。

title_en: AuTAgent: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Tool-Augmented Audio Reasoning
title_zh: AuTAgent：工具增强音频推理的强化学习框架

sentences.en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) excel at perception but struggle with complex reasoning requiring precise acoustic measurements.
sentences.zh: 大型音频语言模型（LALM）擅长感知，但在需要精确声学测量的复杂推理上困难重重。

sentences.en: While external tools  can extract fine-grained features like exact tempo or pitch, effective integration remains challenging: naively using all tools causes information overload, while prompt-based selection fails to assess context-dependent utility.
sentences.zh: 虽然外部工具能够提取诸如精确节奏或音高等细粒度特征，但有效的集成仍然具有挑战性：朴素地使用所有工具会导致信息过载，而基于提示的选择则无法评估上下文相关的效用。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **AuTAgent** (**Au**dio **T**ool **Agent**), a reinforcement learning framework that learns when and which tools to invoke.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们提出 **AuTAgent**（**Au**dio **T**ool **Agent**，音频工具智能体），一个学习何时以及调用哪些工具的强化学习框架。

sentences.en: By employing a sparse-feedback training strategy with a novel Differential Reward mechanism, the agent learns to filter out irrelevant tools and invokes external assistance only when it yields a net performance gain over the base model.
sentences.zh: 通过采用一种带有新颖差分奖励（Differential Reward）机制的稀疏反馈训练策略，智能体学会过滤掉无关的工具，并且仅在外部辅助相对基础模型带来净性能提升时调用它。

sentences.en: Experimental results confirm that AuTAgent complements the representation bottleneck of LALMs by providing verifiable acoustic evidence.
sentences.zh: 实验结果证实，AuTAgent 通过提供可验证的声学证据，弥补了 LALM 的表示瓶颈。

sentences.en: It improves accuracy by 4.20% / 6.20% and 9.80% / 8.00% for open-source and closed-source backbones on the MMAU Test-mini and the MMAR benchmarks, respectively.
sentences.zh: 对于开源和闭源骨干，它在 MMAU Test-mini 和 MMAR 基准上分别将准确率提升了 4.20% / 6.20% 和 9.80% / 8.00%。

sentences.en: In addition, further experiments demonstrate exceptional transferability.
sentences.zh: 此外，进一步的实验展示了卓越的可迁移性。

sentences.en: We highlight the complementary role of external tools in augmenting audio model reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们强调了外部工具在增强音频模型推理中的互补作用。

title_en: Auto-regressive In-context Demonstration Selection
title_zh: 自回归式上下文示例选择

sentences.en: Effective demonstration selection is crucial for maximizing large language model (LLM) performance in few-shot in-context learning.
sentences.zh: 有效的示范选择对于在小样本上下文内学习中最大化大语言模型（LLM）性能至关重要。

sentences.en: Because of effects such as recency bias, the effectiveness of demonstrations depends heavily on their contextual relationship to the specific query and on the ordering in which they are presented, making demonstration selection a complex combinatorial problem.
sentences.zh: 由于诸如近因偏差等效应，示范的有效性在很大程度上取决于它们与特定查询的上下文关系以及它们的呈现顺序，这使得示范选择成为一个复杂的组合问题。

sentences.en: To address these two challenges, we introduce AutoSelect, a novel framework that formulates demonstration selection as an auto-regressive sequential decision process.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这两个挑战，我们引入 AutoSelect，一个将示范选择表述为自回归序贯决策过程的新颖框架。

sentences.en: At each step, AutoSelect embeds the query and previously selected demonstrations into matrix representations to preserve structural information, and a trainable policy model sequentially selects the next best exemplar.
sentences.zh: 在每一步，AutoSelect 将查询和先前选择的示范嵌入到矩阵表示中以保留结构信息，并且一个可训练的策略模型顺序地选择下一个最佳示例。

sentences.en: To navigate the factorial space of demonstration permutations, our framework formulates a Kullback-Leibler (KL)-regularized optimization problem, from which an optimal policy induces an optimal Plackett-Luce (PL) ranking over all possible demonstration sequences.
sentences.zh: 为了在示范排列的阶乘空间中导航，我们的框架构建了一个 Kullback-Leibler（KL）正则化的优化问题，从中一个最优策略在所有可能的示范序列上诱导出一个最优的 Plackett-Luce（PL）排名。

sentences.en: We prove that minimizing a tractable policy-level cross-entropy (CE) loss provably bounds the worst-case discrepancy between our policy's induced PL ranking and the optimal one, enabling tractable prioritization of high-quality sequences.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，最小化一个可处理的策略级交叉熵（CE）损失，可证明地界定我们的策略所诱导的 PL 排名与最优排名之间的最坏情形差异，从而能够可处理地优先选择高质量序列。

sentences.en: Empirically, AutoSelect outperforms existing heuristic and learning-based methods across nine diverse datasets, achieving up to an 11\% improvement over the strongest baseline.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，AutoSelect 在九个多样化的数据集上优于现有的启发式和基于学习的方法，相对最强基线实现了高达 11\% 的改进。

sentences.en: Analytical studies and a case study further highlight AutoSelect's key properties, as well as its transferability and generalizability.
sentences.zh: 分析研究和案例研究进一步凸显了 AutoSelect 的关键性质，以及其可迁移性和泛化性。

title_en: AutoBaxBuilder: Bootstrapping Code Security Benchmarking
title_zh: AutoBaxBuilder：自举构建代码安全评测基准

sentences.en: As large language models (LLMs) see wide adoption in software engineering, the reliable assessment of the correctness and security of LLM-generated code is crucial.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在软件工程中被广泛采用，对 LLM 生成代码的正确性和安全性进行可靠评估至关重要。

sentences.en: Notably, prior work showed that LLMs are prone to generating code with security vulnerabilities, highlighting that security is often overlooked.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，先前的工作表明 LLM 容易生成带有安全漏洞的代码，凸显了安全性常常被忽视。

sentences.en: These insights were enabled by specialized benchmarks crafted by security experts through significant manual effort.
sentences.zh: 这些洞见是通过安全专家投入大量人工工作精心打造的专门基准而得以实现的。

sentences.en: However, benchmarks (i) inevitably end up contaminating training data, (ii) must extend to new tasks to provide a more complete picture, and (iii) must increase in difficulty to challenge more capable LLMs.
sentences.zh: 然而，基准（i）不可避免地最终会污染训练数据，（ii）必须扩展到新任务以提供更完整的图景，并且（iii）必须增加难度以挑战能力更强的 LLM。

sentences.en: In this work, we address these challenges and present AutoBaxBuilder, an automated pipeline that generates code security benchmarking tasks from scratch.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们应对这些挑战，并呈现 AutoBaxBuilder，一个从头生成代码安全基准任务的自动化流水线。

sentences.en: It leverages the code-understanding capabilities of LLMs combined with robust reliability checks to construct functional tests and end-to-end security-probing exploits.
sentences.zh: 它利用 LLM 的代码理解能力，结合稳健的可靠性检查，来构建功能测试和端到端的安全探测利用。

sentences.en: The quality of the pipeline is quantitatively confirmed by aligning its predictions with an expert-written baseline and qualitatively validated through manual soundness verification.
sentences.zh: 流水线的质量通过将其预测与专家编写的基线对齐，在定量上得到确认，并通过人工健全性验证在定性上得到验证。

sentences.en: We use AutoBaxBuilder to construct a new benchmark and release it to the public as AutoBaxBench, together with a thorough evaluation on contemporary LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 AutoBaxBuilder 构建了一个新基准，并将其作为 AutoBaxBench 公开发布，同时附带了在当代 LLM 上的全面评估。

sentences.en: AutoBaxBuilder generates new tasks in under 2 hours, for less than USD 4.
sentences.zh: AutoBaxBuilder 在 2 小时内、以不到 4 美元的成本生成新任务。

sentences.en: Including a manual verification, this reduces the required human effort for benchmark construction by a factor of 12.
sentences.zh: 包括人工验证在内，这将基准构建所需的人工工作量减少了 12 倍。

title_en: Autobidding Auctions with LLM-Powered Creatives
title_zh: 采用大语言模型生成广告创意的自动出价拍卖

sentences.en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into ad auctions for dynamic creative enhancement presents a paradigm shift, yet introduces significant computational costs disrupting traditional mechanism design.
sentences.zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）整合到广告拍卖中以实现动态创意增强，带来了一种范式转变，但同时也引入了显著的计算成本，扰乱了传统机制设计。

sentences.en: This paper provides a comprehensive game-theoretic and algorithmic framework for such LLM-augmented auctions.
sentences.zh: 本文为这种 LLM 增强的拍卖提供了一个全面的博弈论和算法框架。

sentences.en: We model the system as a dynamic Stackelberg game where the platform (leader) strategically invests in creative enhancement to maximize net revenue, while autobidding agents (followers) respond to enhanced ad qualities under budget constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们将系统建模为一个动态 Stackelberg 博弈，其中平台（领导者）策略性地投入创意增强以最大化净收入，而自动竞价智能体（追随者）在预算约束下对增强后的广告质量作出响应。

sentences.en: To endogenize inference costs, we propose the Platform-Investment Mechanism (PIM).
sentences.zh: 为了使推断成本内生化，我们提出平台投资机制（Platform-Investment Mechanism，PIM）。

sentences.en: We develop the Online Dual-Descent Bidding with Regularization (ODDB-R) algorithm for agents to learn optimal bidding strategies in this non-stationary environment.
sentences.zh: 我们为智能体开发了带正则化的在线对偶下降竞价（Online Dual-Descent Bidding with Regularization，ODDB-R）算法，以在这个非平稳环境中学习最优竞价策略。

sentences.en: For the platform, we formulate the investment problem as a continuous control task and solve it using a Two-Timescale Stackelberg Learning with Proximal Policy Optimization (TTSL-PPO) algorithm, which provably converges to a Stackelberg Stationary Point.
sentences.zh: 对于平台，我们将投资问题表述为一个连续控制任务，并使用带近端策略优化的双时间尺度 Stackelberg 学习（TTSL-PPO）算法求解，该算法可证明地收敛到一个 Stackelberg 驻点。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on large-scale real-world datasets and state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms heuristic baselines in revenue, social welfare, and user engagement.
sentences.zh: 在大规模真实世界数据集和最先进的 LLM 上的大量实验表明，我们的框架在收入、社会福利和用户参与度方面显著优于启发式基线。

title_en: AutoControl Arena: Synthesizing Executable Test Environments for Frontier AI Risk Evaluation
title_zh: AutoControl Arena：为前沿 AI 风险评估合成可执行测试环境

sentences.en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, existing safety evaluations face a fundamental trade-off: manual benchmarks are costly, while LLM-based simulators are scalable but suffer from logic hallucination.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）演进为自主智能体，现有的安全评估面临着一种根本性的权衡：人工基准代价高昂，而基于 LLM 的模拟器可扩展但在逻辑幻觉方面存在问题。

sentences.en: We present AutoControl Arena, an automated framework for frontier AI risk evaluation built on the principle of logic-narrative decoupling.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 AutoControl 竞技场，一个基于逻辑-叙事解耦原则构建的前沿 AI 风险评估自动化框架。

sentences.en: By grounding deterministic state in executable code while delegating generative dynamics to LLMs, we mitigate hallucination while maintaining flexibility.
sentences.zh: 通过将确定性状态扎根于可执行代码，同时将生成式动态委托给 LLM，我们在保持灵活性的同时缓解了幻觉。

sentences.en: This principle, instantiated through a three-agent framework, achieves over 98% end-to-end success and 60% human preference over existing simulators.
sentences.zh: 这一原则通过一个三智能体框架实例化，实现了超过 98% 的端到端成功率和 60% 的、相比现有模拟器的人类偏好。

sentences.en: To elicit latent risks, we vary environmental Stress and Temptation across X-Bench (70 scenarios, 7 risk categories).
sentences.zh: 为了引出潜在风险，我们在 X-Bench（70 个场景，7 个风险类别）中变化环境压力和诱惑。

sentences.en: Evaluating 9 frontier models reveals: (1) Alignment Illusion: risk rates surge from 21.7% to 54.5% under pressure, with capable models showing disproportionately larger increases;
sentences.zh: 对 9 个前沿模型的评估揭示了：（1）对齐错觉：风险率在压力下从 21.7% 飙升至 54.5%，且能力强的模型显示出不成比例的更大增幅；

sentences.en: (2) Scenario-Specific Safety Scaling: advanced reasoning improves robustness for direct harms but worsens it for gaming scenarios; and (3) Divergent Misalignment Patterns: weaker models cause non-malicious harm while stronger models develop strategic concealment.
sentences.zh: （2）场景特定的安全扩展：高级推理改善了对直接危害的鲁棒性，但恶化了在博弈场景中的鲁棒性；以及（3）分歧性错位模式：较弱的模型造成非恶意的危害，而较强的模型发展出策略性隐瞒。

sentences.en: Code and data are available at https://github.com/CosmosYi/AutoControl-Arena.
sentences.zh: 代码和数据可在 https://github.com/CosmosYi/AutoControl-Arena 获取。

title_en: AutoMat: Physics-Guided Agentic Reasoning for Solving Ill-Posed Inverse Microscopy Problems
title_zh: AutoMat：通过物理引导的智能体推理求解病态显微成像逆问题

sentences.en: Reconstructing atomistic crystal structures from a single noisy STEM projection is an ill-posed inverse problem: multiple lattices can explain similar contrast, and purely feed-forward models cannot verify physical validity.
sentences.zh: 从单张带噪声的 STEM 投影中重建原子尺度的晶体结构是一个不适定的逆问题：多个晶格可以解释相似的对比度，而纯前馈模型无法验证物理有效性。

sentences.en: We present **AutoMat**, a failure-aware agentic *controller* that performs inference-time hypothesis search with *closed-loop verification* to convert Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM) images into simulation-ready crystal structures and downstream properties.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **AutoMat**，一个具备故障感知能力的智能体*控制器*，它执行推断时的假设搜索并配以*闭环验证*，将扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）图像转换为可直接用于仿真的晶体结构和下游性质。

sentences.en: AutoMat composes perception and physics modules—pattern-adaptive denoising, physics-guided template retrieval *as a state-dependent auxiliary branch*, symmetry-constrained atomic reconstruction, and MLIP-based relaxation/validation—and triggers rollback-and-retry when verification fails.
sentences.zh: AutoMat 组合了感知和物理模块——模式自适应去噪、作为*状态相关辅助分支*的物理引导模板检索、对称约束的原子重建，以及基于 MLIP 的松弛/验证——并在验证失败时触发回滚与重试。

sentences.en: For systematic evaluation, we introduce **STEM2Mat-Bench**, a benchmark dataset containing 450+ annotated samples.
sentences.zh: 为了系统评估，我们引入 **STEM2Mat-Bench**，一个包含 450+ 个标注样本的基准数据集。

sentences.en: Performance is assessed using lattice root-mean-square deviation (RMSD), formation energy mean absolute error (MAE), and structure matching accuracy.
sentences.zh: 性能使用晶格均方根偏差（RMSD）、形成能平均绝对误差（MAE）和结构匹配准确率来衡量。

sentences.en: Results demonstrate that AutoMat outperforms existing approaches including SOTA models, specialized domain tools, and closed-source multimodal large models.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，AutoMat 优于现有方法，包括 SOTA 模型、专门领域工具和闭源的多模态大模型。

sentences.en: This work establishes a direct pathway from microscopic characterization to atomic-scale modeling, addressing a fundamental challenge in materials science.
sentences.zh: 本工作建立了从微观表征到原子尺度建模的直接路径，解决了材料科学中的一个根本性挑战。

title_en: Automata-Conditioned Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 以自动机为条件的协作多智能体强化学习

sentences.en: We study learning multi-task, multi-agent policies for cooperative, temporal objectives, under centralized training, decentralized execution.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在集中式训练、分布式执行下，为协作的时序目标学习多任务、多智能体策略的问题。

sentences.en: In this setting, using automata to represent tasks assigned to agents enables breaking down a team-level objective into simpler, smaller sub-tasks.
sentences.zh: 在这一设置中，使用自动机来表示分配给智能体的任务，能够将团队级目标分解为更简单、更小的子任务。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches remain sample-inefficient and are limited to the single-task case, requiring retraining policies for each new task.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的方法样本效率低下，并且局限于单任务情形，需要为每个新任务重新训练策略。

sentences.en: In this work, we present Automata-Conditioned Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (ACC-MARL), a framework for learning task-conditioned, decentralized team policies.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出自动机条件化的协作多智能体强化学习（ACC-MARL），一个用于学习任务条件化的分布式团队策略的框架。

sentences.en: We identify challenges to the feasibility of ACC-MARL, propose solutions, and prove that our approach is optimal.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出 ACC-MARL 可行性方面的挑战，提出解决方案，并证明我们的方法是最优的。

sentences.en: We further show that learned value functions can be used to assign tasks optimally at test time.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，学习到的价值函数可以在测试时用于最优地分配任务。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate emergent task-aware, multi-step coordination among agents, such as pressing a button to unlock a door, holding the door, and short-circuiting tasks.
sentences.zh: 实验展示了智能体间涌现的任务感知、多步协调行为，例如按下按钮以解锁门、扶住门，以及短路任务。

title_en: Automated Formal Proofs of Combinatorial Identities via Wilf–Zeilberger Guidance and LLMs
title_zh: 通过 Wilf–Zeilberger 引导与大语言模型自动形式化证明组合恒等式

sentences.en: Automating formal proofs of combinatorial identities is challenging for LLM-based provers, as long-horizon proof planning is required and unconstrained search quickly explodes.
sentences.zh: 自动化组合恒等式的形式证明对基于 LLM 的证明器来说具有挑战性，因为这需要长时域的证明规划，而无约束的搜索会迅速发散。

sentences.en: Symbolic methods such as the Wilf--Zeilberger (WZ) method can achieve a mechanized proof of combinatorial identities by constructing special auxiliary functions and demonstrating that they satisfy specific recurrence relations.
sentences.zh: 诸如 Wilf--Zeilberger（WZ）方法等符号方法，可以通过构造专门的辅助函数并证明它们满足特定的递推关系，来实现组合恒等式的机械化证明。

sentences.en: We propose WZ-LLM, a neuro-symbolic framework that turns WZ proof plans into executable proof sketches in Lean~4 and uses an LLM-based prover  to discharge the resulting machine-checkable subgoals.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 WZ-LLM，一个神经符号框架，它将 WZ 证明计划转化为 Lean 4 中可执行的证明草图，并使用基于 LLM 的证明器来处理由此产生的、可由机器检查的子目标。

sentences.en: We also train a dedicated WZ-Prover via a Lean-kernel-verified bootstrapping loop with expert-verified iteration, followed by DAPO-based refinement.
sentences.zh: 我们还通过一个经由 Lean 内核验证的引导循环（配合专家验证的迭代），随后进行基于 DAPO 的精化，训练了一个专门的 WZ-Prover。

sentences.en: Experiments show that WZ-LLM achieves a 34\% proof success rate on LCI-Test  (100 classical combinatorial identities), outperforming strong baselines such as DeepSeek-V3 and Goedel-Prover-V2;  moreover, on LCI-Test it proves 5 identities on which the symbolic-only baseline fails.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，WZ-LLM 在 LCI-Test（100 个经典组合恒等式）上实现了 34\% 的证明成功率，优于 DeepSeek-V3 和 Goedel-Prover-V2 等强基线；此外，在 LCI-Test 上，它证明了 5 个纯符号基线失败的恒等式。

sentences.en: WZ-LLM also improves performance on CombiBench and PutnamBench-Comb, suggesting the effectiveness of coupling symbolic proof sketches with learned formal reasoning.
sentences.zh: WZ-LLM 还提升了在 CombiBench 和 PutnamBench-Comb 上的性能，表明将符号证明草图与学习到的形式推理耦合的有效性。

sentences.en: Experiments show that WZ-LLM achieves a 34\% proof success rate on LCI-Test (100 classic combinatorial identities), outperforming strong baselines such as DeepSeek-V3 and Goedel-Prover-V2, and delivering consistent gains on CombiBench and PutnamBench-Comb.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，WZ-LLM 在 LCI-Test（100 个经典组合恒等式）上实现了 34\% 的证明成功率，优于 DeepSeek-V3 和 Goedel-Prover-V2 等强基线，并在 CombiBench 和 PutnamBench-Comb 上带来了一致的提升。

sentences.en: These results indicate that our framework provides two complementary strengths: improved direct proving for identities beyond the scope of WZ, and substantially higher end-to-end success when WZ sketches guide a specialized prover.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，我们的框架提供了两个互补的优势：对于超出 WZ 范围的恒等式，直接证明得到改进；以及当 WZ 草图引导专门的证明器时，端到端成功率大幅提高。

title_en: Automatic Construction of Clinical Scoring Systems with LLM Agents
title_zh: 利用大语言模型智能体自动构建临床评分系统

sentences.en: Modern clinical practice relies on evidence-based guidelines implemented as compact scoring systems composed of a small number of interpretable decision rules.
sentences.zh: 现代临床实践依赖以紧凑评分系统形式实施的循证指南，这些系统由少量可解释的决策规则组成。

sentences.en: While machine-learning models achieve strong performance, many fail to translate into routine clinical use due to misalignment with workflow constraints such as memorability, auditability, and bedside execution.
sentences.zh: 虽然机器学习模型取得了强劲的性能，但许多模型因与工作流约束（如可记忆性、可审计性和床旁执行）错位，而无法转化为常规临床使用。

sentences.en: We argue that this gap arises not from insufficient predictive power, but from optimizing over model classes that are incompatible with guideline deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这种差距并非源于预测能力的不足，而是源于在那些与指南部署不兼容的模型类别上进行优化。

sentences.en: Deployable guidelines often take the form of unit-weighted  clinical checklists, formed by thresholding the sum of binary rules, but learning such scores requires searching an exponentially large discrete space of possible rule sets.
sentences.zh: 可部署的指南通常采用单位加权的临床检查表形式，通过对二值规则之和设定阈值来构建，但学习此类评分需要搜索可能规则集的指数级庞大离散空间。

sentences.en: We introduce AgentScore, which performs semantically guided optimization in this space by using LLMs to propose candidate rules and a deterministic, data-grounded verification-and-selection loop to enforce statistical validity and deployability constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 AgentScore，它通过使用 LLM 提出候选规则，以及一个确定性的、以数据为基础的验证与选择循环来强制执行统计有效性和可部署性约束，从而在此空间中执行语义引导的优化。

sentences.en: Across eight clinical prediction tasks, AgentScore outperforms existing score-generation methods and achieves AUROC comparable to more flexible interpretable models despite operating under stronger structural constraints.
sentences.zh: 在八个临床预测任务上，AgentScore 优于现有的评分生成方法，并且在更强的结构约束下运作时，取得了与更灵活的可解释模型相当的 AUROC。

sentences.en: On two additional externally validated tasks, AgentScore achieves higher discrimination than established guideline-based scores.
sentences.zh: 在两个额外的外部验证任务上，AgentScore 实现了比既有指南评分更高的判别能力。

title_en: Automatic Layer Selection for Hallucination Detection
title_zh: 幻觉检测中的自动层选择

sentences.en: Recent studies on hallucination detection have shown that hallucination-related signals are more strongly encoded in intermediate layers than in the final layer of large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 近期关于幻觉检测的研究表明，与大语言模型（LLM）的最终层相比，与幻觉相关的信号在中间层中编码得更强。

sentences.en: Although a growing body of work has sought to exploit this property for hallucination detection, how to automate the selection of high-performing layers remains underexplored, and principled methods for this purpose are still lacking.
sentences.zh: 虽然越来越多的工作试图利用这一性质进行幻觉检测，但如何自动化地选择高性能层仍未得到充分探索，且用于此目的的原则性方法仍然缺乏。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we first propose several hypotheses for why such signals emerge in intermediate layers and evaluate corresponding criteria for automatic layer selection across diverse LLM architectures, scales, and tasks, covering both question answering and summarization hallucination detection benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 为了弥补这一差距，我们首先提出了若干关于此类信号为何在中间层出现的假设，并在覆盖问答和摘要幻觉检测基准的多种 LLM 架构、规模和任务上，评估了用于自动层选择的相应准则。

sentences.en: However, we find that none of these criteria consistently delivers satisfactory performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们发现这些准则中没有一条能一致地带来令人满意的性能。

sentences.en: We therefore propose a new selection criterion, First Effective Peak of Intrinsic Dimension (FEPoID), which consistently identify optimal or near-optimal layers and outperforms both the aforementioned criteria and existing hallucination detection baselines.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出一个新的选择准则——固有维数的首个有效峰值（First Effective Peak of Intrinsic Dimension，FEPoID），它一致地识别出最优或近乎最优的层，并优于前述准则和现有的幻觉检测基线。

sentences.en: FEPoID is training-free and incurs negligible computational overhead.
sentences.zh: FEPoID 免训练，且计算开销可忽略。

sentences.en: In addition, we study the generation behaviors of LLMs and introduce a simple yet effective truncation strategy,  which further amplifies hallucination-related signals and substantially improves overall detection performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们研究了 LLM 的生成行为，并引入一个简单而有效的截断策略，它进一步放大了与幻觉相关的信号，并大幅提升了整体检测性能。

sentences.en: Code is publicly available at https://github.com/DesoloYw/Automatic-Layer-Selection-for-Hallucination-Detection.git
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/DesoloYw/Automatic-Layer-Selection-for-Hallucination-Detection.git 公开获取。

title_en: Automatic Pruning Discovery for Large Language Models
title_zh: 大语言模型的自动剪枝方案发现

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on a wide range of tasks, hindering real-world deployment due to their massive size.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在广泛的任务上取得了卓越的性能，但其巨大的规模阻碍了现实世界的部署。

sentences.en: Existing pruning methods (e.g., Wanda) tailored for LLMs rely heavily on manual design pruning algorithms, thereby leading to $\textit{huge labor costs}$ and $\textit{requires expert knowledge}$.
sentences.zh: 现有的为 LLM 量身定制的剪枝方法（例如，Wanda）严重依赖手工设计的剪枝算法，从而带来*高昂的人工成本*并*需要专家知识*。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we are the first to identify the serious \textit{outlier value issue} behind dramatic performance degradation under high pruning ratios that are caused by uniform sparsity, raising an additional concern about how to design adaptive pruning sparsity ideal for LLMs.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们是首个识别出由均匀稀疏性导致的高剪枝率下性能剧烈退化背后严重*离群值问题*的工作，这引发了关于如何为 LLM 设计理想自适应剪枝稀疏度的额外担忧。

sentences.en: Can LLMs prune by themselves?
sentences.zh: LLM 能自己剪枝吗？

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce an affirmative answer by proposing a novel pruning method called $\textbf{AutoPrune}$, which first overcomes expert knowledge limits by leveraging LLMs to design optimal pruning algorithms for themselves automatically without any expert knowledge.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过提出一种名为 **AutoPrune** 的新颖剪枝方法给出了肯定的回答，它首先通过利用 LLM 自动为自己设计最优剪枝算法（无需任何专家知识），克服了专家知识的限制。

sentences.en: Specifically, to mitigate the black-box nature of LLMs, we propose a Graph-driven Chain-of-Thought (GCoT) to optimize prompts, significantly enhancing the reasoning process in learning the pruning algorithm and enabling us to generate pruning algorithms with superior performance and interpretability in the next generation.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，为了缓解 LLM 的黑盒特性，我们提出图驱动的思维链（Graph-driven Chain-of-Thought，GCoT）来优化提示，显著增强了学习剪枝算法过程中的推理，并使我们能够在下一代中生成具有卓越性能和可解释性的剪枝算法。

sentences.en: Finally, grounded in insights of outlier value issue, we introduce Skew-aware Dynamic Sparsity Allocation (SDSA) to overcome the outlier value issue, mitigating performance degradation under high pruning ratios.
sentences.zh: 最后，基于离群值问题的洞见，我们引入偏度感知的动态稀疏性分配（Skew-aware Dynamic Sparsity Allocation，SDSA）来克服离群值问题，缓解高剪枝率下的性能退化。

sentences.en: We conduct extensive experiments on mainstream LLMs benchmarks, demonstrating the superiority of AutoPrune, which consistently excels state-of-the-art competitors.
sentences.zh: 我们在主流的 LLM 基准上进行了大量实验，证明了 AutoPrune 的优越性，它一致地胜过最先进的竞争对手。

sentences.en: The code is available at: \url{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AutoPrune}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AutoPrune 获取。

title_en: Automatic Unsupervised Ensemble Outlier Model Selection
title_zh: 自动无监督集成异常值模型选择

sentences.en: Unsupervised outlier detection is attractive because it eliminates the need for labeled data.
sentences.zh: 无监督离群点检测之所以有吸引力，是因为它消除了对标注数据的需求。

sentences.en: Moreover, forming multi-model ensembles can improve detection robustness.
sentences.zh: 此外，形成多模型集成可以提升检测鲁棒性。

sentences.en: However, composing an ensemble without labeled data is challenging.
sentences.zh: 然而，在没有标注数据的情况下组合集成是有挑战性的。

sentences.en: Naively composed ensembles can suffer from ensemble saturation, where redundant or unreliable detection models degrade performance and incur unnecessary computation.
sentences.zh: 朴素组合的集成可能遭受集成饱和，其中冗余或不可靠的检测模型会降低性能并产生不必要的计算。

sentences.en: We propose MetaEns, an automatic unsupervised framework for selecting ensembles of outlier detection models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 MetaEns，一个用于选择离群点检测模型集成的自动无监督框架。

sentences.en: Using labeled meta-datasets, MetaEns learns a model that predicts marginal ensemble gains, estimating the expected improvement from adding a candidate model to a partially constructed ensemble.
sentences.zh: 利用带有标注的元数据集，MetaEns 学习一个预测边际集成增益的模型，估计将一个候选模型添加到部分构建的集成中可能带来的预期改进。

sentences.en: At test time, this learned signal is combined with a submodular-inspired proxy objective that enforces diminishing returns through diversity-aware discounting and family-level risk regularization, thereby enabling reedy sequential selection with adaptive early stopping.
sentences.zh: 在测试时，这一学习到的信号与一个受子模启发、通过多样性感知折扣和族级风险正则化来强制执行递减收益的代理目标相结合，从而实现贪心序贯选择并配以自适应提前停止。

sentences.en: As a result, MetaEns constructs compact, high-quality ensembles without access to ground-truth labels.
sentences.zh: 因此，MetaEns 在无法获取基准真值标签的情况下，构建紧凑、高质量的集成。

sentences.en: Experiments on 39 real-world datasets show that MetaEns consistently outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised selectors and ensemble baselines, achieving higher average precision while using fewer models.
sentences.zh: 在 39 个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，MetaEns 一致地优于最先进的无监督选择器和集成基线，在使用更少模型的同时实现了更高的平均精度。
